body:
Holiday weekends are a notoriously tough time for grassroots, small-dollar fundraising — can you help us catch up?
#
Peter, we know you're wrapping up a busy and hopefully relaxing long holiday weekend, so we'll keep it brief.
**Here's the deal:** Long holiday weekends are a notoriously tough time for grassroots, small-dollar fundraising because people check their email less frequently! That's a problem when grassroots contributions make up a significant chunk of our overall fundraising.
**So when we hit a fundraising slowdown like the one we're in right now,_every single contribution_ has a bigger impact than before. **
Thankfully, the month isn't over yet — and we still have time to close our fundraising gap before we have to worry about missing our 2,900 contribution goal. Hi Peter,

We wanted to share three HUGE reasons why we need to defeat Mike Garcia in November:
1. **He's is ready to pass a national abortion ban if Republicans retake the majority.** He co-sponsored the Life at Conception Act, signed an amicus brief to the Supreme Court to overturn _Roe v. Wade_ , and is one of the biggest recipients of anti-choice PACs.
2. He takes campaign contributions from **the most nefarious special interests _imaginable:_** the gun lobby, the fossil industry, and far-right, dark money super PACs.

body:
Happy Memorial Day, Peter!I have been thinking recently about our Veterans and the tremendous love and respect I have for them. We truly owe a debt of gratitude to the men and women who have served in our military. Our servicemen and women stand as sentries between us and those who seek to harm our country. Not enough is done for the heroes who bravely serve our country. Because of their service, we can enjoy our freedoms in the greatest country on Earth. [](https://fitzs-scottfitzgerald.cmail20.com/t/t-l-qddkujt-yuhdluddtl-r/) I am committed to making sure that our Veterans get the care and services they deserve. As your voice in Congress, I will always prioritize ensuring they get the benefits and resources they earned serving our great nation.From the bottom of mine and my family's hearts, I want to wish you and your families a blessed Memorial Day. Thank you and God Bless America,
**Scott Fitzgerald** [](https://fitzs-scottfitzgerald.cmail20.com/t/t-l-qddkujt-yuhdluddtl-y/) [](https://fitzs-scottfitzgerald.cmail20.com/t/t-l-qddkujt-yuhdluddtl-j/) [](https://fitzs-scottfitzgerald.cmail20.com/t/t-l-qddkujt-yuhdluddtl-t/)[](https://fitzs-scottfitzgerald.cmail20.com/t/t-l-qddkujt-yuhdluddtl-h/) | Paid for by Scott Fitzgerald for Congress

body:
When I was growing up, parents worried about college indoctrinating their kids into radical socialists. Now, the indoctrination
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znqgjf64m6mrto3o6ggndvm09jj56rgl7rreso0o_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tthm2rjec5n6co6bc72mloe3ddie9jr9c9im3hrcd3kstijfdr4c8qefchge9rjfkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p36phimiqj1ptim9j33c5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)
| | | Hello, When I was growing up, parents worried about college indoctrinating their kids into radical socialists. Now, the indoctrination is starting even earlier. Here are some recent examples that shocked me.
---
* Teachers are being forced to accept that math is a form of white supremacy.
* The National Education Association is calling on Biden to stop vouchers to private schools and no new charter schools. The goal seems to be to put all education under government control.
* Our public schools are being taken over by social justice advocates who believe everything is political, including grade school education.

---
All is not lost! I believe we have to take our education into our own hands. And I think I have found a solution. **I want to introduce you to Connor Boyack. He is the author of the Tuttle Twins.** The Tuttle Twins is a book series, teaching children about free markets, private property rights, and the ideas of our Founding Fathers.

[**Can you support teaching younger generations about the ideas of liberty? Please click here to donate to the Tuttle Twins >>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4ohd7cd5q4n8hainp81op8pedg40qje8sedmhc8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) Connor created the series when he realized there were no children’s books teaching these important topics. Connor’s organization, Libertas Institute, is on a mission to distribute 1,000,000 copies of the Tuttle twins into the hands of homeschooled children, public schools, and libraries across the country during 2021.
---
---
_2 million copies of the Tuttle Twins have been distributed to families and children across the country. _
---
The Tuttle Twins are a solution for parents or community members who are worried about the future of education. I told Connor I would help him raise $50,000 to distribute 5,000 copies of the Tuttle Twins. Here is how you can help Connor and Libertas Institute. [**Will you join me and donate $10, $25, $50, $100, or more to Libertas Institute and help us fight back against the socialists’ indoctrination in our schools? Click here to donate >>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zo3vfbjr5a5v9cfmr7aonbciohljn58esrcsgqlg_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) **One more important point... All online donations are being matched by one of the Libertas Institute’s biggest supporters, John P. You can double your impact! If you donate $100, John will personally match it with another $100 gift.*** Here’s how your support goes into distributing thousands of copies of the Tuttle Twins.
---
1. Libertas Institute is working with like-minded teachers and librarians to place books in school classrooms across the country.
2. They will also give teachers a lesson plan so students have an alternative to what is being taught in their textbook.
3. To accomplish our mission, the Libertas Institute will need funds to print and distribute these books.[**It costs roughly $10 to produce and ship each book.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zjh6qpvefqbc681d1n0ufjd1iruatjiodq9a35v8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs)

---
**Please select an amount below to rush your support to help us fight back against socialism in our education.**
---
[**Donate 1 Tuttle Twins book for $10 Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zf2mpk4slhaibnd2aoi862q98nrp6me08lnug93o_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) [**Donate 2 Tuttle Twins book for $20 Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zcrt481bnmgk7hbagqc720s62i5i37q8hekkq1qg_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) [**Donate 5 Tuttle Twins book for $50 Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfn82n7k2jg4a1to6u3dalcc5324d2nikuc9bq70_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) [**Donate 10 Tuttle Twins book for $100 Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpelpk8c09dum2lun5tbo1lj4jjokk9l0mrbhtf8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) [**Donate 25 Tuttle Twins book for $250 Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z8n7nhln9qder9q2s2flbdiucivpsnqpk1uf8qs8_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) [**Donate 50 Tuttle Twins book for $500 Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zluk2k5r2kj1lin4tnqfu9es08bj83qg1jiuav58_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) [**Donate 100 Tuttle Twins book for $1,000 Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zunsq7hmsv9i1cimk45kl8hd09aim51a5pdb0au0_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) [**Donate Any Amount Here >>>**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z73n6h3anmn3rae9sr5d1bhicr8ufojmfhe60f38_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs)
---
I almost forgot one other important point...children enjoy the books! It’s not going to be a chore teaching kids about the ideas of freedom. Over two million books have been sold because families love them so much. I have been in the halls of Congress long enough to know that we cannot rely on Congress, or anyone in DC for that matter, to guarantee freedom in the future. We must actively take part in the education of our country’s future citizens. Please send your urgent support today and help participate in this noble cause. [**Here is the link to donate again.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3c2trtvm3nkgf436c2qs3rhiqb8rjr55qlem080_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2clh2bs) Thank you,
---

Senator Mike Lee

Lewis. In fact, our free online course, **“[ An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance,](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zm3i576lmacmab4tpggunpug16u4tjr3ihd3qmpg_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2c3h2bs)” **has more than 500,000 people enrolled. C.S. Lewis was a war hero, a bright light during some very dark hours in world history. He is one of my absolute favorite authors because... ...While you may know him for his landmark _Chronicles of Narnia_ series, he was also a brilliant philosopher, writer, and Christian apologist. That’s why we decided to develop this online course. Since launching **“[An Introduction to C.S. Lewis: Writings and Significance](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z65mdeepbhlr39cq9vm0p3o5384q1b1f73s67lho_rp22sh2s8i66pb6cjie8oj2c3h2bs),” **we’ve received an outpouring of thanks for offering a course that covers the breadth and scope of Lewis’ writings. Given how popular this course is, the DVD box set won’t last long. Paulette Smith is the Second Former 6th District Candidate to Endorse Jake Evans
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001YKwFwggOaiXJTpKA77gum02YZ7f_8CvTwLhZnbg-oASCXRSJroFgLQVgjuw5D762Q6NoO55vzri_-1GKQgD_j327VU8zWqrzrG8HWFP9RoYZmyHpAdKO95wh4Uqip2okVizN3sMa5Qk=&c=Ls2K70-xvNlsUqVOT3PnULEPQbUFB57f7_EYxyzkH1k4Xs5yAUAZZQ==&ch=rVZwr5uL1RivSiQuMKa8SlhNgjFu9J97ghvxGttX-z8Y_JVPelbc5Q==)
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE May 31st, 2022
Paulette Smith endorses Jake
---
|
---
| Two former 6th District candidates have now joined the team Former 6th Congressional District Republican candidate, Paulette Smith, is calling on her friends and supporters to vote for Trump-endorsed Jake Evans in the coming runoff. "I ran on the slogan, 'We the people, not the politicians,' and I'm endorsing Jake Evans because he's in this for the people, too," said Smith. "I worked hard to elect President Trump, and Jake will champion the America First values that make us great. I'm proud to join President Trump in fighting to elect one of the people, not a politician, to Congress." Smith is now the second former candidate in the 6th Congressional District race to back Jake. "We may have been opponents at one point, but Paulette and I became friends through this campaign, bound by a common desire to work for the people of Georgia and to make America great," Jake said. "She's a patriot, a strong voice for the MAGA movement and I appreciate her support."

I had the honor of delivering a Memorial Day Keynote at the Goochland County Courthouse with American Legion Post 215.

The day we no longer have men and women willing to sacrifice for our freedom, we will no longer have a country. That is how important their service is.

Words alone cannot repay the debt we owe these men and women who gave their all for us. What can we do? We can live a life worthy of their sacrifice.

My father, an Army veteran, and my wife Tracy joined me. It was great to see so many fellow veterans and fellow citizens there as well to honor and remember our fallen.

Hi Friend,
I am reaching out because there are less 14 hours left before our fundraising deadline - the last deadline before the primaries.
I am fired up and ready to challenge Lankford this fall, but the first step to do that is getting on the general election ballot. The primaries take place on June 28th and that election will determine who is the Democratic candidate facing off with Lankford in the general election in November and we have six challengers.
That means we have only 30 days left before the votes are cast to determine who will take on Lankford this fall. And this is the final fundraising deadline before that date.
Meeting our fundraising goal will allow us to reach more undecided voters, build a bigger platform, and prove that we are campaign Lankford needs to take seriously. So please - if you can - please donate to help my campaign hit our fundraising goal this month.
We are in the homestretch and this deadline could
make a big difference.

Thank you as always.
— Madison

body:
Folks, I know that many of us are feeling discouraged right now.

The past month has been gut-wrenching.

But I am not willing to stop fighting for the families I represent or the future my son, and all of our children, deserve.

Because I believe if we work together, we can continue to build a future where the lives of Americans are worth more than the profits of gun manufacturers, where white supremacy has finally been dismantled, and folks of all backgrounds have an equitable chance at achieving their dreams.

Our work will not be easy. Our path will be arduous. We will face more tragedies and struggles ‐‐ but we will meet them together.

If you are with me, I'm asking you to give whatever you can to our end-of-month grassroots fundraising drive. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/lewis_2022email?refcode2=mayemails] We are closing in on our goal, but we still need 47 more people to step up with what they can before midnight so we can keep reaching voters in this critical election year.

In solidarity,

Jazz

| Jake Evans, the Trump-endorsed Constitutional Warrior in the 6th District race, today called on RINO Rich McCormick to return or give to victim charities the donations he's received from the anti-gun American Medical Association, which this week reiterated its demands for strict anti-Second Amendment measures that would violate Americans' constitutional rights to defend themselves. "It's said you can know a person by the company he keeps, and RINO Rich McCormick will happily take money from any group - and tell them what they want to hear - even if they stand for liberal principles that offend Georgia conservatives," Jake said. "This is one example of many where I have the support of America's most trusted conservative leaders and RINO Rich is supported by liberal groups who can spot a RINO with the accuracy of a safari guide. I call on RINO Rich to return the anti-gun rights special interest groups' donations or distribute the money to the families of victims of recent gun violence - or admit that he's aligned with the special interest groups' anti-gun views. "My views on the Second Amendment are clear. I'm horrified and sickened by the gun crime we're seeing in our country, and we must find solutions. But anti-constitutional gun control measures would do nothing to deter criminals. By definition, they don't care about the law. I'm committed to ensuring that every law-abiding Georgian has the right to defend themselves from the out-of-control crime wave nurtured by leftist policies in Democratic cities."
RINO Rich McCormick is: • A failed politician who has been running for Congress for 39 consecutive months in two separate districts • Is funded and owned by liberal special interest groups • Getting 75 percent of his campaign funding from out of state "RINO Rich did not vote for President Trump in 2016 and lied about it and is endorsed by the most liberal caucus of the Republican Party," Jake said. "Failed, swampy politicians like RINO Rich are destroying America. If RINO Rich does not stand with the special interest groups' anti-gun rights positions, then I call on him to return the money that he took from them or give it to a worthy cause."

"It's said you can know a person by the company he keeps, and RINO Rich McCormick will happily take money from any group - and tell them what they want to hear - even if they stand for liberal principles that offend Georgia conservatives," Jake said. "This is one example of many where I have the support of America's most trusted conservative leaders and RINO Rich is supported by liberal groups who can spot a RINO with the accuracy of a safari guide. I call on RINO Rich to return the anti-gun rights special interest groups' donations or distribute the money to the families of victims of recent gun violence - or admit that he's aligned with the special interest groups' anti-gun views. "My views on the Second Amendment are clear. I'm horrified and sickened by the gun crime we're seeing in our country, and we must find solutions. But anti-constitutional gun control measures would do nothing to deter criminals. By definition, they don't care about the law. I'm committed to ensuring that every law-abiding Georgian has the right to defend themselves from the out-of-control crime wave nurtured by leftist policies in Democratic cities." RINO Rich McCormick is: • A failed politician who has been running for Congress for 39 consecutive months in two separate districts • Is funded and owned by liberal special interest groups • Getting 75 percent of his campaign funding from out of state "RINO Rich did not vote for President Trump in 2016 and lied about it and is endorsed by the most liberal caucus of the Republican Party," Jake said. "Failed, swampy politicians like RINO Rich are destroying America. If RINO Rich does not stand with the special interest groups' anti-gun rights positions, then I call on him to return the money that he took from them or give it to a worthy cause." | | | | == | == == | | | | | | | Jake Evans for Congress | P.O. subject: Do you believe in Abby?

body:
This is both an opportunity and a challenge ...
| | |
---
Hey, Peter, it's Daniel (Abby's husband). First, I wanted to say thank you for being a part of this team. We're building a true grassroots movement, and I really appreciate you being a part of it. Second, I wanted to provide a few important updates ahead of Abby's biggest end-of-month fundraising deadline at 11:59 p.m. TONIGHT.

Let's back up a bit and talk about Abby's opponent: Sen. Grassley (R-IA), who is facing RECORD-LOW approval with Iowa voters. He's spent his seven terms in office advancing far-right ideologies and sabotaging efforts to help working families. Dear
Friend,

I hear
from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their
heroes. For those people-and you may be among them-I'm thrilled
to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you,
absolutely free: "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the
Rich."

"Tax cuts
for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower
tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy
Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the
federal government?

Hoover
Institution Senior Fellow Thomas Sowell takes an empirical
approach in his commentary, "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts
for the Rich."

Sowell
separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses
real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all
actually lead to greater revenue for the government.

As a
friend and supporter of the Hoover Institution, we are proud to
offer you this valuable, thought-provoking resource free of
charge. Click here to get your free copy of "Trickle Down" Theory
and "Tax Cuts for the Rich" now.

Thanks,
Greg

name: Mo Brooks
subject: the 3 battlelines in DC →
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Mo Brooks for Senate Committee |
body:
| | | [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r)
---
Dear Peter, Why does Mitch McConnell hate my guts? Why has McConnell poured over $12 million into my home state of Alabama, with the goal of trying to destroy my conservative record? **This is Congressman Mo Brooks. I'm one of the**** _most conservative_****members of the United States House of Representatives. ** For over a decade in Congress, I've fought socialist liberals who are trying to destroy our country, and weak-kneed, debt junky RINOs who are addicted to big spending, and just want their place at the trough. They're afraid of the media, and afraid to stand up and do what's right. I've been a thorn in their side in the House, and will absolutely stand on principle in the Senate. Mitch McConnell knows that, and that's why he's determined to stop me. He's already poured millions into my race, and with just four weeks until Election Day, the attacks are ramping up. I desperately need your help
---
[**DONATE NOW >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r)
---
[**You can tell a lot about a person by who their friends are. My friends Ted Cruz, Rand Paul, Marjorie Taylor Green and Jim Jordan ALL have endorsed my campaign and are working to help me.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r) I'll shoot straight with you: the GOP establishment leadership has **NEVER** liked me, not even for even one day. I've made their lives pretty miserable, whether it's standing up to them for their illegal immigration giveaways when they try to help the Chamber of Commerce import more cheap labor to compete with American workers, or their OUTRAGEOUS government spending, I've been a world-class pain in the neck for RINOs. Mitch McConnell knows this, and that's why he is hell-bent on making sure I am _never_ seated in the United States Senate. When I ran for Senate in a special election to replace Jeff Sessions in 2017,_**McConnell spent over $9 MILLION**_ dollars to defeat me in my Alabama Republican Primary--and we almost won!
---
[**JOIN THEM SUPPORT MO BROOKS >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r)
---
Peter, in order for you to understand why this race is so very important, you need to know the situation we have right now in Washington: the battle lines are drawn in 3 directions on Capitol Hill: On one side, you've got the _" Big Government, Big Business, pro-illegal aliens, pro-big spending"_**** Republicans, led by _Mitch McConnell,_ and the Washington GOP establishment. **These people hate Donald Trump, they hate his voters, and wish we would all go away so that they can get back to business as usual.** On another side, you've got Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, AOC, The Squad, and the most liberal Democratic Party in American history. **These people hate America and are hostile to her. They hate America's history. They believe that America is the "bad guy" in the world and that America has to be fundamentally remade. What's more, they hate working people, they hate our values, they hate every single thing that we stand for. **
---
[**DRAIN THE SWAMP >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r)
---
And then finally, in the smallest minority in Washington, you've got conservatives like me: **ROCK SOLID** , Donald Trump, America First, pro-life, pro-gun, pro-religious freedom, small government conservatives who are sick of the radical left and their attempts to remake this country, and also JUST AS SICK of the Big Government RINO crowd who enables them!
---
[**SUPPORT GRASSROOT CONSERVATIVES**** >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r)
---
There aren't enough of us in DC, but you know who we are: Patriots like Rand Paul, and Jim Jordan and Ted Cruz, and yes, DONALD TRUMP and DONALD TRUMP Jr. Those are the battle lines, Peter. Those are the stakes. For way too long, I've heard conservatives say, "What do I care who wins a primary in a red state like Kansas, or Missouri, or Alabama?" Well, THIS is why, right here. Please read this next line carefully, because it's the most important thing I'm going to say in this whole letter to you: **EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE.** Let me say that again: [**EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r) Even if we gain control of the Senate, if we don't have solid conservatives in the Senate, if we have moderates like Mitch McConnell, Mitt Romney, and Susan Collins calling the tune, we will still _always_ lose. They will sell us out, they will fail, and then, to add insult to injury, they will blame conservatives. That's why we MUST win primaries in Red States. That's why we must have a new majority leader. **And that's why it's so critically important that I win this Senate race in Alabama.** [**But I can't do that without you. I need your support, because McConnell and his allies are already on TV in Alabama supporting my opponents. **](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r) Quite simply, we are outgunned by the amount of money being shoveled from Washington, DC into Alabama. Peter, we are headed into the stretch run of this battle in Alabama, a battle for the heart and soul of the Republican Party, and for the United States Senate. I'm all in for the conservative movement, and I'm all in for America. **Will you join me?**
---
[**STAND WITH MO BROOKS**** >>**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r)
---
For America, Mo Brooks _P.S. I'm in a battle for the United States Senate seat here in Alabama. Ted Cruz, Rand Paul and MTG have all endorsed me, but Mitch McConnell and the Washington establishment who hate Trump are doing their best to stop me._[**_Will you join me today?_**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491957:J1MF5BoNa:m:1:3317145305:D2C32F9CC9594E003CD03FD0589F1C26:r)

They're afraid of the media, and afraid to stand up and do what's right. I've been a thorn in their side in the House, and will absolutely stand on principle in the Senate. Mitch McConnell knows that, and that's why he's determined to stop me. He's already poured millions into my race, and with just four weeks until Election Day, the attacks are ramping up. I desperately need your help I'll shoot straight with you: the GOP establishment leadership has NEVER liked me, not even for even one day. I've made their lives pretty miserable, whether it's standing up to them for their illegal immigration giveaways when they try to help the Chamber of Commerce import more cheap labor to compete with American workers, or their OUTRAGEOUS government spending, I've been a world-class pain in the neck for RINOs. Mitch McConnell knows this, and that's why he is hell-bent on making sure I am never seated in the United States Senate. When I ran for Senate in a special election to replace Jeff Sessions in 2017,McConnell spent over $9 MILLION dollars to defeat me in my Alabama Republican Primary--and we almost won! Peter, in order for you to understand why this race is so very important, you need to know the situation we have right now in Washington: the battle lines are drawn in 3 directions on Capitol Hill: On one side, you've got the " Big Government, Big Business, pro-illegal aliens, pro-big spending"** Republicans, led by Mitch McConnell, and the Washington GOP establishment. These people hate Donald Trump, they hate his voters, and wish we would all go away so that they can get back to business as usual. On another side, you've got Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, AOC, The Squad, and the most liberal Democratic Party in American history. These people hate America and are hostile to her. They hate America's history. They believe that America is the "bad guy" in the world and that America has to be fundamentally remade. What's more, they hate working people, they hate our values, they hate every single thing that we stand for. And then finally, in the smallest minority in Washington, you've got conservatives like me: ROCK SOLID , Donald Trump, America First, pro-life, pro-gun, pro-religious freedom, small government conservatives who are sick of the radical left and their attempts to remake this country, and also JUST AS SICK of the Big Government RINO crowd who enables them! There aren't enough of us in DC, but you know who we are: Patriots like Rand Paul, and Jim Jordan and Ted Cruz, and yes, DONALD TRUMP and DONALD TRUMP Jr. Those are the battle lines, Peter. Those are the stakes. For way too long, I've heard conservatives say, "What do I care who wins a primary in a red state like Kansas, or Missouri, or Alabama?" Well, THIS is why, right here. Please read this next line carefully, because it's the most important thing I'm going to say in this whole letter to you: EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE. Let me say that again: Even if we gain control of the Senate, if we don't have solid conservatives in the Senate, if we have moderates like Mitch McConnell, Mitt Romney, and Susan Collins calling the tune, we will still always lose. They will sell us out, they will fail, and then, to add insult to injury, they will blame conservatives. That's why we MUST win primaries in Red States. That's why we must have a new majority leader. And that's why it's so critically important that I win this Senate race in Alabama. Quite simply, we are outgunned by the amount of money being shoveled from Washington, DC into Alabama. Peter, we are headed into the stretch run of this battle in Alabama, a battle for the heart and soul of the Republican Party, and for the United States Senate. I'm all in for the conservative movement, and I'm all in for America. Will you join me?** For America, Mo Brooks P.S. I'm in a battle for the United States Senate seat here in Alabama. name: Richard Blumenthal
subject: There's too much at stake to fall short
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blumenthal for Connecticut
body:
[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=PsGL28Nk1gk1Feh%2FDniGEIaij8mjc3YK&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend, if even one seat flips red in November, the GOP will regain Senate control - which is why Mitch McConnell and his allies are watching my campaign closely for any sign of vulnerability.
But before I continue, I want to take a moment to share how grateful I am for your continued support. When it matters most, I can always count on you to step up. Thank you.
**With our critical end-of-month fundraising deadline quickly approaching, we 're forecasted to fall $2,461 short of what we need to stay on track.**
**But we cannot ignore the urgency of this moment: we cannot signal to Mitch McConnell and the entire GOP establishment that they should target Connecticut 's Senate seat. We cannot allow ourselves to fall into that position - not when so much is at stake.**
Not when the Republicans in the Senate blocked a defensive violence prevention bill that the House passed just days ago in response to this country's endless gun violence epidemic.1
Not when Oklahoma has banned abortion outright. And a new women's healthcare clinic in Casper, Wyoming, has been torched right before it opens.2
Not when millions are expected to be stripped of their reproductive healthcare at any given moment by the Trump-weighted Supreme Court, and GOP leaders like Mitch McConnell are weighing the possibility of a _national_ abortion ban if they retake Senate control.
Not when I'm facing radical opponents who - if elected - will be a rubber stamp on disastrous policies like tax hikes on millions of seniors and low-income Americans.
**A Republican majority would be a _nightmare_ for our country. That's why coming up short on big goals like this is simply not an option. So please, I'm counting on _you_ to help me close this budget gap and ensure we have the resources to bolster our campaign operations to defend this seat - for safety from gun violence, reproductive rights, accountability for Donald Trump, and so much more.**
**I know you 're someone who cares deeply about protecting Senate control, so I hope you'll come through today in this critical moment for our nation: [Please, before my end-of-month deadline, will you donate $5 or more to defend this Senate seat and keep the Senate sane? Every bit of grassroots support will make a critical difference in the challenging months ahead.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1190-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
With so much gratitude,
Dick

body:

| Utah businessman, community leader, and former Springville Mayor Wilford Clyde has publicly endorsed Ally Isom for U.S. Senate. [Watch his video on YouTube here.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001D1VOeIvgmShKiUP1_n_u7gjhvCA_JusffuabUHLFJH4LHLmQts76bZuUmCZhhCemciaZ_fOEBI6yL9Je_WLZ5h5z55ELJuYe_yY8EldEoR-eY62-gXt9MLMvBAniZNCZ7AlcvI3GrrvIlhlabBNdtQ==&c=zqVOETodFLdx5pCZN2T1H2vLT-mUPHWAQVwncJmvfqLCGMQ1xnNYuw==&ch=J9LW5mHvIIIoCDcJUrOD5ONxi0PWUe6fBcyWtcNS7PGAdTZVUdye4w==)
"I'm supporting Ally for U.S. Senate, because I think we need a change in our government and I think she's the person that can do that for us."
Ally looks at people first, listens to them, and knows their concerns. She is a person that is accessible to all people in Utah.
"I think if you examine what she is doing, you'll find that she is a candidate you can get behind and support. I urge you to vote for Ally Isom."

Ally knows Utah. Ally understands the issues important to Utahns and will actively work to:
* Reduce inflation and strengthen the economy
* Cut wasteful government spending, pass a budget reduction plan, and lead out on a balanced budget amendment
* Protect and defend Utah's water, secure water infrastructure, and fight for local control of public land
* Ensure America is a global energy leader
* Support Hill Air Force Base and Utah's defense economy
* Support first responders and law enforcement
* Support Utah businesses and working families
* Pass term limits

Ally believes that government closest to the people governs best and will bring real solutions to these important issues. She is a conservative who fights for the right things and will fight for Utah.

|
---
| | | [](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62887%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=7wI8eiCHxZAZLzASgyeJ1Q&sysid=1) Fellow Conservative, Liberals can’t keep their story straight about Critical Race Theory. They insist, “Critical Race Theory isn’t being taught in schools!” Critical Race Theory most certainly _is_ being taught in the schools. Parents all over the country have noticed _and they’re not happy about it_. But the instruction in anti-whiteness is part of a much larger plan to **“fundamentally transform”** our country. (Remember Barack Obama?). These steely-eye zealots have taken over our schools, our universities, our media, our corporations -- even our sports leagues for Pete’s sake! Why might that be? **_Because they want your kids._** This is your opportunity to get conservatives **_on_** to school boards -- and Critical Race Theory **_out_** of classrooms. [ **I want to stop Critical Race Theory** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62888%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ya21JUI4RfXxHD6yLRGIEw&sysid=1) It’s called the **School Board Campaign Training**. It’s run by the best conservative training group in America called the **Leadership Institute**. With this new training, the Leadership Institute brings savvy, experienced campaign experts and teachers to teach conservatives how to overcome the odds and win those school board races. **What a great way to help thousands of “Davids” beat the odds -- and the left!** Morton and his staff started this newest training online. Because in these COVID-crazy times, it’s still not easy to bring together big crowds in restrictive, liberal-run states. By having most of these trainings online, the Leadership Institute can reach much, much larger audiences (maybe you shouldn’t have shut down the country, liberals!). Experienced LI trainers can now get to any potential conservative school board candidate **_anywhere, anytime_**. The LI team put together eleven hours of nuts-and-bolts videos detailing everything conservatives need to need to know to beat back the left and save kids from brainwashing **in hating America**. **Conservatives who take the course learn how to:**
* Plan a winning campaign.
* Design and run a successful Get-Out-the-Vote operation.
* Craft a compelling message.
* Handle scrutiny from their opponent and the media.
* And much more.

To get a conservative parent through the online training costs $50 -- and to send someone through the in-person version costs $100. The folks at LI don’t play around. They aim to train as many conservatives as possible. But for this month, their goal is to raise $20,000 -- to train 200 more conservatives online and 100 in-person. [**Will you donate $50 today to train someone online? Or give $100 to send a conservative through the in-person training?**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62889%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=SY6MUAs6jQ9L145%2boWWVtA&sysid=1) [ **Yes, I'll help train one more conservative school board candidate** ](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62880%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=flAZl2bz7bCFKR%2be8xT6Fw&sysid=1) With many school board positions up for election this year, now’s the time to act. **Your gift by the end of this month** will train one more conservative how to run for their local school board -- and win. **HERE'S WHAT ONE conservative who took the training, Natalie from Colorado, had to say:** “After learning about Critical Race Theory last summer and seeing what is being taught in our schools, I’ve come to understand the damage caused for students and our country.

**I can no longer sit on the sidelines and wait for someone else to solve the problem.** It’s time to overhaul the public school system, and we must start locally.” **In its first few months, LI’s School Board Campaign Training has enrolled 1,700 conservatives.** [**Your gift of $50, $100, or more will help the Leadership Institute stop leftists from warping kids’ minds and ruining our country.**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62881%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xZ8tMsDpZxcacAroBspRqQ&sysid=1) Please don’t wait to [**make your tax-deductible contribution**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62882%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=d0yuc35Kaw3hqA96L3VDYg&sysid=1) to the Leadership Institute today. Thank you! Let’s Save America, Ann Coulter
Author and Columnist P.S. Let’s get Critical Race Theory insanity _out of our classrooms_ and _into the dustbin of history_ **Please help these efforts with your generous gift today. You’ll drive the left nuts -- while you save America.** So what are you waiting for? [**Please give right away!**](http://click.greatamericaupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=41%7c62883%7c612934%7c1%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=hnLVFqcBahgC7Pb54maQ2w&sysid=1) Thank you. | Folks,

I hope you enjoyed your holiday weekend.

Between the lead up to our special election primary and our first post-primary end-of-month fundraising goal, I know we’ve asked for your support a lot this month. I have to reach out to ask one last time before the month ends.

Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is 11:59 pm tonight, and we need to raise the last $2,855 to meet our goal before time runs out. Could you give $25, $50, or an amount that works for you right away? I want to say thank you to Ben for his decision to run, and for making his campaign positive and focused on the issues. It takes courage and dedication to put oneself out for public office. _**Right now is the moment for us to come together and focus on defeating Wagner this November.** _My pitch to voters has remained the same: I care about you, and the well being of your family; I am a member of your community, and am committed to true public service; and I will win this election for all of us and serve every single one of my constituents—not just those who agree with me. **Our team has been building and perfecting our operation from Day 1**. I have made it a priority to build a top-to-bottom operation that can persuade new voters and turn out every single voter who is ready for change when it counts, on Election Day. [_**I have won in a traditionally Republican district before, and will do it again. To win, we must work together to build a groundswell of support in this district between now and Election Day. I need your help to bring the fight directly to Ann Wagner. Enough Googling. Today I’ll tell you about my tattoos myself.

---
Hey friend, it's John.

We both know I don’t look like a typical politician. Maybe that’s why my tattoos are *literally* the first thing people Google about me.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45949248/348179542/1140246662?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&refcode=mh-jtk1081-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTgzZWU2ZC1mYmUwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=42wU_znPdtxYh3jd-VcN7Ll5Snmtfq9FOPgZtjWqCIw=)
Well enough Googling. Today I’ll tell you about my tattoos myself.

**On my left arm I have the zip code 15104.** That’s Braddock, Pennsylvania, my home and the community I was honored to serve as mayor for 15 years. Gisele and I are raising our kids here in Braddock, right across the street from Andrew Carnegie’s first steel mill.
**On my right arm I have nine different dates.** These are the dates when people were killed through violence in Braddock while I served as Mayor, starting in 2006. Seven out of nine were gun deaths. I actually have to get one more date added because in June of 2018, there was another tragic loss of life. My heart breaks every time I’m reminded of that.
My first tattoo came after January 16, 2006. It was my second week on the job as mayor after winning my election by a single vote. I received a call and was summoned to a police crime scene where a pizza delivery man had been robbed and killed by gun violence.

**Every time Braddock lost someone was the worst feeling in the world, friend. **

In a close-knit community like Braddock, it’s very likely that you know the victim and their family. It’s an incredibly wrenching and personal experience as a mayor — but nothing compared to what the families have to go through.

In my 13 years as mayor, I worked with the community to take on gun violence and other important issues that Braddock faced every day. I helped initiate youth + art programs for the students of our community and we worked together to create a community center.

We also worked to develop buildings that had been written off, kick-started our economy, and reduced deadly violence. My proudest moment as mayor of Braddock is when our community went 5 1⁄2 years without the loss of life due to gun violence.
Friend, I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania because I believe *every* community is worth fighting for. Just like Braddock.

It is my promise to you that I'll fight for you + your community as if it were my very own. That promise is written on my arms. Literally. ❤️
In order to build the kind of Democratic U.S. Senate campaign that can flip Pennsylvania blue + fight for every community, however, the honest truth is that we need to raise a lot of money right now. A big part of that is online activists like you chipping in when you can.

**And now that I am *officially* the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate, the team and I could *really* use everyone’s help right now.**

So, I gotta ask:

[**Will you please split $10 or more between our campaign and Senator Maggie Hassan's campaign right now, friend? Every dollar helps send me to the U.S. Senate where I’ll fight like hell for your community just like I fight for mine.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45949249/348179543/1140246662?amounts=3,10,25,50,100&amount=10&refcode=mh-jtk1081-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzNTgzZWU2ZC1mYmUwLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=42wU_znPdtxYh3jd-VcN7Ll5Snmtfq9FOPgZtjWqCIw=)
Thanks for all you do. Together, I *know* we can win this.

Let’s gooooo. 🔥

John

John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

subject: Why I'm running for Congress

body:
| | Peter,

I am running for Congress because I am sick and tired of what's happening in D.C. My special election is in less than 1 month, and I'm facing 47 other candidates!

Yes, you read that right...47 other candidates!

That's why I'm reaching out to you right now. I need your help; I need your family's help; I need your neighbor's help. I've seen firsthand the power of grassroots support, and that's why I'm reaching out to you today. _**[I'm not afraid to put up a fight. Are you?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60494930:65SyjZoNm:m:1:3317145305:D9B031DAAE05029BC42EC2EC735AB232:r "I’m not afraid to put up a
fight. Are you?")**_

---
| | | [Join My Team](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60494930:65SyjZoNm:m:1:3317145305:D9B031DAAE05029BC42EC2EC735AB232:r)
---

If I win, I am ready to roll up my sleeves on day one and get to work slashing budgets, cutting taxes, standing up to liberal special interests, and standing up for the American people. However, I need every single person reading this to immediately step up and take action to make this possible.

We have less than 2 months until my election, which is why your immediate support is especially important. _**[I'm ready to fight for you and I need your help.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60494930:65SyjZoNm:m:1:3317145305:D9B031DAAE05029BC42EC2EC735AB232:r "I’m ready to fight for you and I need your help. ")**_

---
| | | [Donate Now](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60494930:65SyjZoNm:m:1:3317145305:D9B031DAAE05029BC42EC2EC735AB232:r)
---

Washington D.C. is full of out-of-touch politicians who want to tax and spend their way out of every problem.

With skyrocketing inflation, out-of-control spending, and crippling national debt, our country can't afford two more years of Democrats controlling DC.

That's why I'm running for Congress.

I'm ready to fight for America by slashing budgets, cutting taxes, and standing up for ALL people.

Washington will never change if we keep sending the same big-spending, status quo politicians to Congress. I'm ready to bring commonsense policies and actions to Washington, but I can't do it without you.

_**[So I have just one question: Will you join me?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60494930:65SyjZoNm:m:1:3317145305:D9B031DAAE05029BC42EC2EC735AB232:r "So I have just one question: Will you join me?")**_

Thank you and God Bless America,

Sarah Palin

name: Mo Brooks
subject: Fire Mitch McConnell?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Mo Brooks for Senate Committee |
body:
| | | [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r)
---
Dear Peter, Why does Mitch McConnell hate my guts? Why has McConnell poured over $12 million into my home state of Alabama, with the goal of trying to destroy my conservative record? **This is Congressman Mo Brooks. I'm one of the**** _most conservative_****members of the United States House of Representatives. ** For over a decade in Congress, I've fought socialist liberals who are trying to destroy our country, and weak-kneed, debt junky RINOs who are addicted to big spending, and just want their place at the trough. They're afraid of the media, and afraid to stand up and do what's right. I've been a thorn in their side in the House, and will absolutely stand on principle in the Senate. Mitch McConnell knows that, and that's why he's determined to stop me. He's already poured millions into my race, and with just four weeks until Election Day, the attacks are ramping up. I desperately need your help
---
[**DONATE NOW >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r)
---
[**You can tell a lot about a person by who their friends are. My friends Ted Cruz, Rand Paul, Marjorie Taylor Green and Jim Jordan ALL have endorsed my campaign and are working to help me.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r) I'll shoot straight with you: the GOP establishment leadership has **NEVER** liked me, not even for even one day. I've made their lives pretty miserable, whether it's standing up to them for their illegal immigration giveaways when they try to help the Chamber of Commerce import more cheap labor to compete with American workers, or their OUTRAGEOUS government spending, I've been a world-class pain in the neck for RINOs. Mitch McConnell knows this, and that's why he is hell-bent on making sure I am _never_ seated in the United States Senate. When I ran for Senate in a special election to replace Jeff Sessions in 2017,_**McConnell spent over $9 MILLION**_ dollars to defeat me in my Alabama Republican Primary--and we almost won!
---
[**JOIN THEM SUPPORT MO BROOKS >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r)
---
Peter, in order for you to understand why this race is so very important, you need to know the situation we have right now in Washington: the battle lines are drawn in 3 directions on Capitol Hill: On one side, you've got the _" Big Government, Big Business, pro-illegal aliens, pro-big spending"_**** Republicans, led by _Mitch McConnell,_ and the Washington GOP establishment. **These people hate Donald Trump, they hate his voters, and wish we would all go away so that they can get back to business as usual.** On another side, you've got Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, AOC, The Squad, and the most liberal Democratic Party in American history. **These people hate America and are hostile to her. They hate America's history. They believe that America is the "bad guy" in the world and that America has to be fundamentally remade. What's more, they hate working people, they hate our values, they hate every single thing that we stand for. **
---
[**DRAIN THE SWAMP >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r)
---
And then finally, in the smallest minority in Washington, you've got conservatives like me: **ROCK SOLID** , Donald Trump, America First, pro-life, pro-gun, pro-religious freedom, small government conservatives who are sick of the radical left and their attempts to remake this country, and also JUST AS SICK of the Big Government RINO crowd who enables them!
---
[**SUPPORT GRASSROOT CONSERVATIVES**** >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r)
---
There aren't enough of us in DC, but you know who we are: Patriots like Rand Paul, and Jim Jordan and Ted Cruz, and yes, DONALD TRUMP and DONALD TRUMP Jr. Those are the battle lines, Peter. Those are the stakes. For way too long, I've heard conservatives say, "What do I care who wins a primary in a red state like Kansas, or Missouri, or Alabama?" Well, THIS is why, right here. Please read this next line carefully, because it's the most important thing I'm going to say in this whole letter to you: **EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE.** Let me say that again: [**EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r) Even if we gain control of the Senate, if we don't have solid conservatives in the Senate, if we have moderates like Mitch McConnell, Mitt Romney, and Susan Collins calling the tune, we will still _always_ lose. They will sell us out, they will fail, and then, to add insult to injury, they will blame conservatives. That's why we MUST win primaries in Red States. That's why we must have a new majority leader. **And that's why it's so critically important that I win this Senate race in Alabama.** [**But I can't do that without you. I need your support, because McConnell and his allies are already on TV in Alabama supporting my opponents. **](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r) Quite simply, we are outgunned by the amount of money being shoveled from Washington, DC into Alabama. Peter, we are headed into the stretch run of this battle in Alabama, a battle for the heart and soul of the Republican Party, and for the United States Senate. I'm all in for the conservative movement, and I'm all in for America. **Will you join me?**
---
[**STAND WITH MO BROOKS**** >>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r)
---
For America, Mo Brooks _P.S. I'm in a battle for the United States Senate seat here in Alabama. Ted Cruz, Rand Paul and MTG have all endorsed me, but Mitch McConnell and the Washington establishment who hate Trump are doing their best to stop me._[**_Will you join me today?_**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60491860:6Bs7jZoNi:m:1:3253819041:374DB8E5AE53C2A90CD1117050860FB2:r)

I've made their lives pretty miserable, whether it's standing up to them for their illegal immigration giveaways when they try to help the Chamber of Commerce import more cheap labor to compete with American workers, or their OUTRAGEOUS government spending, I've been a world-class pain in the neck for RINOs. Mitch McConnell knows this, and that's why he is hell-bent on making sure I am never seated in the United States Senate. When I ran for Senate in a special election to replace Jeff Sessions in 2017,McConnell spent over $9 MILLION dollars to defeat me in my Alabama Republican Primary--and we almost won! Peter, in order for you to understand why this race is so very important, you need to know the situation we have right now in Washington: the battle lines are drawn in 3 directions on Capitol Hill: On one side, you've got the " Big Government, Big Business, pro-illegal aliens, pro-big spending"** Republicans, led by Mitch McConnell, and the Washington GOP establishment. These people hate Donald Trump, they hate his voters, and wish we would all go away so that they can get back to business as usual. On another side, you've got Joe Biden, Chuck Schumer, AOC, The Squad, and the most liberal Democratic Party in American history. These people hate America and are hostile to her. They hate America's history. They believe that America is the "bad guy" in the world and that America has to be fundamentally remade. What's more, they hate working people, they hate our values, they hate every single thing that we stand for. And then finally, in the smallest minority in Washington, you've got conservatives like me: ROCK SOLID , Donald Trump, America First, pro-life, pro-gun, pro-religious freedom, small government conservatives who are sick of the radical left and their attempts to remake this country, and also JUST AS SICK of the Big Government RINO crowd who enables them! There aren't enough of us in DC, but you know who we are: Patriots like Rand Paul, and Jim Jordan and Ted Cruz, and yes, DONALD TRUMP and DONALD TRUMP Jr. Those are the battle lines, Peter. Those are the stakes. For way too long, I've heard conservatives say, "What do I care who wins a primary in a red state like Kansas, or Missouri, or Alabama?" Well, THIS is why, right here. Please read this next line carefully, because it's the most important thing I'm going to say in this whole letter to you: EVEN IF REPUBLICANS HAVE CONTROL OF THE SENATE, CONSERVATIVES WILL ALWAYS LOSE IF RINOS ARE IN CHARGE. Let me say that again: Even if we gain control of the Senate, if we don't have solid conservatives in the Senate, if we have moderates like Mitch McConnell, Mitt Romney, and Susan Collins calling the tune, we will still always lose. They will sell us out, they will fail, and then, to add insult to injury, they will blame conservatives. That's why we MUST win primaries in Red States. That's why we must have a new majority leader. And that's why it's so critically important that I win this Senate race in Alabama. Quite simply, we are outgunned by the amount of money being shoveled from Washington, DC into Alabama. Peter, we are headed into the stretch run of this battle in Alabama, a battle for the heart and soul of the Republican Party, and for the United States Senate. I'm all in for the conservative movement, and I'm all in for America. Will you join me?** For America, Mo Brooks P.S. I'm in a battle for the United States Senate seat here in Alabama. clean_body: We’re fighting for our progressive future, and we have to hit this deadline | | | | | Peter, We have to close the books on May at midnight tonight, and right now, we’re falling short of where we need to be. It’s really important we hit goals like this one (I’ll explain why in a second!), = I won’t sugarcoat it for you: we’re in a tough fight for our progressive values and future here in Michigan’s new 11th District. We’re up against an opponent who won’t vote to cut military spending to meet human needs, or support urgent proposals to tackle climate change, or stand up for human rights everywhere — and who has received tons of special interest money to fuel her campaign. Our agenda is on the line here, Peter, and it’s this team that will carry us to victory. With early voting starting so soon, it’s only a matter of time before the attack ads and negative campaigning starts against us. That’s why hitting this end-of-month deadline is so important: so we have the funds to fight back — and win. = I’m proud of the work we accomplished together, and it’s only the beginning. Thank you for being on this team, and fighting with me for the progressive values that the people of Michigan deserve. Together, we’ll get this done. Your support means the world to me. Let’s go! Friend, I appreciate your help so much.

This month has been a whirlwind, but today we're closing out our end-of-month fundraising deadline with a huge goal. Sarah Palin and her campaign are out raising us. Though right now we're statistically tied with her in the polls, she's no stranger to funneling dark money into this race to win.

**[If everyone reading this donated $5 right now, we'd show Palin our strength, with just 12 days until the special election. We can take back Alaska's only House seat for hard working families and everyday people – and all that starts with $5. Please, donate today>>](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45951119/348188097/1403725775?refcode=em22_220531_eom4_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NTQ4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzE5MjMyMy0wMmUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V4pDPGvzuieZbmsotqXoF8vjm2TugLwh4uqQoW2FcjE=)** [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45951120/348188098/1403725775?refcode=em22_220531_eom4_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NTQ4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMzE5MjMyMy0wMmUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=V4pDPGvzuieZbmsotqXoF8vjm2TugLwh4uqQoW2FcjE=) When people ask me why I decided to run for Congress, it's often hard to find the right words.

It's not because I don't have a good reason, it's because I have **_too many_** good reasons to choose just one:

I am running _for my children_ because they deserve a planet where natural resources are plenty and life is sustainable -- a place where they can raise children, if they so choose.

I am running _for my Alaskan neighbors_ , who pay the most out of any state for health care, and deserve better than insurance that breaks the bank.

body:
Peter, I'm currently on vacation at the beach and experienced something powerful last night. I went to the little boardwalk theme park with my friends. I should have been happy and laughing all night but I was not. I teared up, sad and very angry. It was the first time I've been around kids since the elementary school shooting in Uvalde, Texas where 19 kids and 2 teachers were mowed down with an assault rifle. As I looked around at the young kids here having fun with their parents, riding rides, playing games and eating candy, I know that the parents of 19 ELEMENTARY SCHOOL kids won't be enjoying their Memorial Day this year, and every year from now on, because their innocent child was shot to death with a weapon of war. It was a powerful and sad experience to see kids playing that were the same age as the victims in Uvalde. So young and precious and loving life and having fun.

**[Pride Fund needs your help right now to keep up our fight for gun safety and elevate our advocacy efforts. Can you donate today to help us in the fight?](https://act.myngp.com/el/cjIOkraO76OhYNtETbFNRCDs5WgUUGeKfWiJrBhVIBE=/UOOvTJs4Arprqg0AbsJZFdBmOYpM0fhoxB7HCeyQlls=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes)** [](https://act.myngp.com/el/cjIOkraO76OhYNtETbFNRCDs5WgUUGeKfWiJrBhVIBE=/UOOvTJs4Arprqg0AbsJZFdBmOYpM0fhoxB7HCeyQlls=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes) It makes me sick and nauseous that Republican lawmakers stand with the gun lobby and will not even consider ANY measure to curb violence. Even if you take gun reform out of the equation, and only focus on school safety, they won't even address that either. No additional police officers for schools or metal detectors. Republican lawmakers care more about guns and unborn babies than the safety of our kids. It is sad that in recent years, gun violence became the number one killer of kids in America. Our country is at a crossroads of whether we are going to just let this be the permanent "normal" way we live or whether we all take a stand and DO something as a country to stop this epidemic. The 2nd Amendment includes the phrase "WELL REGULATED MILITIA" yet we are not well regulated. There are commonsense solutions that would respect the second amendment while taking steps to save lives. We must do so.

**[Please click and donate today so we can expand our efforts to save lives from gun violence. We raise most of our funds from emails like this. You have the power to make a difference. Donate now.](https://act.myngp.com/el/cjIOkraO76OhYNtETbFNRCDs5WgUUGeKfWiJrBhVIBE=/UOOvTJs4Arprqg0AbsJZFdBmOYpM0fhoxB7HCeyQlls=?refcode=2022&amount=25&recurring=yes)**
In solidarity, Jason Lindsay

clean_body: Peter, I'm currently on vacation at the beach and experienced something powerful last night. I went to the little boardwalk theme park with my friends. I should have been happy and laughing all night but I was not. I teared up, sad and very angry. It was the first time I've been around kids since the elementary school shooting in Uvalde, Texas where 19 kids and 2 teachers were mowed down with an assault rifle. As I looked around at the young kids here having fun with their parents, riding rides, playing games and eating candy, I know that the parents of 19 ELEMENTARY SCHOOL kids won't be enjoying their Memorial Day this year, and every year from now on, because their innocent child was shot to death with a weapon of war. It was a powerful and sad experience to see kids playing that were the same age as the victims in Uvalde. So young and precious and loving life and having fun. It makes me sick and nauseous that Republican lawmakers stand with the gun lobby and will not even consider ANY measure to curb violence. Even if you take gun reform out of the equation, and only focus on school safety, they won't even address that either. No additional police officers for schools or metal detectors. Republican lawmakers care more about guns and unborn babies than the safety of our kids. It is sad that in recent years, gun violence became the number one killer of kids in America. Our country is at a crossroads of whether we are going to just let this be the permanent "normal" way we live or whether we all take a stand and DO something as a country to stop this epidemic. The 2nd Amendment includes the phrase "WELL REGULATED MILITIA" yet we are not well regulated. There are commonsense solutions that would respect the second amendment while taking steps to save lives. We must do so. In solidarity, Jason Lindsay | To help us grow this movement, will you please forward this email to 2 friends to get them involved? subject: Our Campaign is Moving Forward
body:
| | | |
---
| I AM ON THE BALLOT!!!
---
| |
---|---
|
I hope you had a great Memorial Day Weekend enjoying the freedoms that we enjoy and remembering the cost that was paid to keep us free.

This past Thursday my campaign team and I submitted considerably more signatures to be placed on the ballot! Friday they were approved and I am officially on the August 9 ballot. Support for me came from all corners of the 2nd District. I hope to build on that grassroots support to win the 2nd Congressional District in November. Yes, I said to win the 2nd District! Both Democrats, as well as Republican leaders, scoff at that. A culture of defeat permeates Republican leadership, but not the grassroots members of our party. When times have been difficult in this campaign, it's the grassroots support that has buoyed my spirit.

I am not minimizing the task ahead. Mark Pocan left $800,000 in his 2020 campaign account that he had no need to spend. He can raise limitless sums from the wealthy coastal elites that finance him. So, can a young working-class woman from Iowa County defeat Pocan and his limitless budget? We shall see. But no campaign volunteer will outwork me, no paid campaign staffer will outwork me, and I am positive Mark Pocan won't outwork me. I've driven 40,000 miles around the district since my first campaign speech in Waunakee in May of last year, and I'm just getting started.

This is the year that Republicans can win the 2nd Congressional District. President John F. Kennedy once said, "If not us, who? If not now, when?" I believe for the 2nd District, the time is now.
Charity Barry

| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

God Bless,
Joanie Shoemaker

body:
| | | Team, My name is Afeni, and I’m Mckayla’s Deputy Campaign Manager. I wanted to let you know that **we are fewer than 50 days until election day** (and early voting starts before then!). Our campaign operation is in an all-out blitz until the July 19 primary: **we’re knocking on thousands of doors per week, talking to countless voters who have been left behind by the corporate Democratic Party establishment.** **[_Your support now is more important than ever. Can we count on you for a $15 contribution to help power our movement?_ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zFAc3Wx6QcT5KV8XYmGwPOHoHvPtUn_qVvaia4mC9vRReU0w9OOxfzn2LhI5kmRQkybnPPgfDZjpfZUeMhUYtjVc07RZGV-A8m7MI63XcT3Llf72pQRyDeojpc0UTK68nMINCxOBUTzqVEAyQg5Cxi6C2PrlcuUUBVOXTXw1KhmmhvoadF5_GVmUdJLo6vAhnNlGfyZXOUJnoEh5OtYe9bAr_LkV4YiPb76v0luK74TeNy_J-ZyRLgeFasRif3qpmZG6EfleTbBVptZn2-mW0LWzeJCB7Qj0Thp6kz-nZAkg/3mi/WRA-wM3gRX2d_TGBkkiyCQ/h0/vBa-H05EFBAGlYkwQg9_Fp8CH7k7B-p_FAGIxbLKN3w)** Steny Hoyer usually spends his time rubbing shoulders with big-money donors (fossil fuel executives, weapons manufacturers, and the like), raising millions of dollars for his corporate-funded war-chest. **MAY END-OF-MONTH FUNDRAISING DEADLINE**

Peter,

Here we are - it’s May 31st and we’ve got a midnight fundraising deadline that has our campaign a bit worried. While we’ve been in this position more than 20 times before, it never really gets easy trying to close the gap between what we’ve raised in a particular month and what is left to raise before the clock strikes midnight.

Here is where we stand as of right now:
1. May was always going to be a hard month. We’re not going to match what we raised in April.

2. Democrats have already spent more than $6 million in Oregon to elect Democrats and smear the reputation of respectable Republicans.

3. With only six seats standing between Republicans and the House majority, every seat matters. I’ve said this time and again – but our fundraising has been suffering a bit.

| | From the Desk of Dr. Ben Carson: Hello, I feel like our culture has forgotten—or ignored—some very important and basic lessons when it comes to the development of human life. Our society has been infected by an anti-life ideology, treating its most vulnerable members as disposable objects. Abortion that was once thought of as a last resort in a medical emergency has become the new normal. Medicine tells us that life begins at the moment of conception. It also tells us when an unborn baby develops a heartbeat, brainwaves, and nervous system. Yet, despite all of this, the unborn are not treated as though they are alive or even human. **As a surgeon, I have operated on infants pre-birth. I can assure you that they are very much alive.** [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh51e100ve3kq0pbft2ucqgen5ggmk7hp07sgoc0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1i61oj1chh2bs)
_Dr. Ben Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute_ Life is a precious gift that has been given to us from our creator. No person is disposable, and every life is precious according to Him. I believe that everyone deserves life, even those who have been denied this right by our society. I believe that together we can make a difference and bring dignity and a voice to the unborn. I also believe that I’m not alone in this belief. I believe that you believe that too. I’ve started working with a group of like-minded individuals who are looking to change our culture. We want to build a society that values life but that takes people like you and I making a commitment. The first step is clearly stating what we believe and what we are willing to do to protect the lives of the unborn. [**Will you join me today and stand up for those who cannot do it for themselves?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z2mq63u4htbtg11i84q58if141bd5f391hnfekt0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1i61oj1chh2bs) I’ve created a new pro-life pledge; I’d love your support. Would you read the pledge below to see if you align with our shared goals and are willing to commit to fighting for the lives of the unborn? [https://offers.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-statement/](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zk2ee9ashsdoil1evb46pg7gkah240k6905fr9p0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1i61oj1chh2bs) Regards,
Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman
American Cornerstone Institute

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z31h4ksl6lq3p6da3gt3qgt2vs3uossg55dagm0g_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk1p7fcdkmcqjas3h6gonact66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2uthb3clic1hmdc74e5h68s36epj7eppi6or78s9hmso70sph6th74c5hchqbcppnq9o74p1m62p6csjk65r61o5kckoe1d9hcjj6cphhmsqr0o3mc5j71d5jchjr1db5e8gq48bi4bh28or5c5g68p74chge49fg)
This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zu2t5pthv7h7aq6gsg02mq8v79f6dk52u0gu2e5o_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1i69p34c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation’s future. A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That’s why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ztblt2suf0s2bd1ct3fcrkvgd40akba3iogd0vo8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1i69p34c3h2bs)** For most of our nation’s history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. **But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.** This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America’s schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don’t understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching **millions** of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left’s domination over most of our schools, include:
* **Teaching** millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as “Constitution 101” and “The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;”
* **Reaching** over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale’s free digest of liberty;
* **Promoting** constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;
* **Sending** millions of pocket-size copies of America’s founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and
* **Restoring** excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale’s Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide.

Your answers to the **National Survey on Presidential Selection** will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College. **And this is especially important in this critical time for America’s future.** So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our **National Survey on Presidential Selection** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. **You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6kr75g9p80mdgcll4u2uiaieqcn0p34anvntclo_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1i69p34c3h2bs)** And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been “pursuing truth and defending liberty.” Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

clean_body: | | | | Peter, The news has been overwhelming lately. Back-to-back mass shootings. The Supreme Court is poised to overturn Roe v. Wade. Reports on the climate crisis grow more dire by the day. And rising prices threaten to chip away at working families hard-earned economic gains. It's a lot to take in. Times like these call for strong leadership. That's why Val Hoyle is the leader Oregon needs right now. = = Val is the only candidate in this race who has a record of delivering for working families. As a state legislator, she passed major legislation to curb gun violence, protect abortion rights, and raise the minimum wage. And as Labor Commissioner she goes to bat for workers every single day. Val's opponent, Alek Skarlatos, is a far-right MAGA Republican who is a terrible fit for Oregon and for this moment. He doesn't have the experience of getting things done that Val has, and he doesn't know the communities of this district. Alek doesn't have a record to stand on, so he's calling in favors from big MAGA donors across the country. It's the same playbook he used when he ran against Peter DeFazio in 2020. And Peter? It's working. Alek has already raised nearly $2 million. How do we combat Alek's attempt to buy this election? Grassroots support! People like you will make all the difference in this race. =. clean_body: | | | | \------ | Peter, I know that my team emailed you, but I wanted to make sure I personally touched base with you. We now have just a few hours left in May, facing our biggest deadline to date, and we are still $2,200 SHORT of our goal. I love everything about Wyoming, and I want to ensure it is protected from the Washington, DC and northern Virginia elite like Liz Cheney -- that’s why it’s so critical that you step up, and contribute. | | | | | Remember, Donald Trump won the state of Wyoming with 70% of the vote. That means we should be represented by someone who holds the same values – that is me; I am an America First and Wyoming First no-nonsense conservative who is willing to fight for you. Liz Cheney is completely out of touch with the people of Wyoming, and that’s exactly why I am running, to ensure you and your values are accurately represented in Congress. As an attorney who has battled against the Establishment and unelected bureaucrats for decades, I’ve NEVER backed down from a challenge, and I’m not going to start now. I hope I can count on you, to step up, and fight with me for the future of Wyoming and America. you, | | Harriet Hageman | | | | | DONATE BY MAIL: Hageman for Wyoming P.O. Box 4157, Cheyenne, Wyoming 82003
