name: Dr. Robert Jeffress
subject: Thinking about heaven
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsCQItThhN

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osCQItThhN

Hello
Friend,
Have you
ever caught yourself wondering what heaven will be like? Of
course you have.
As
Christians, we know someday we will leave this world and be
united with God in heaven, yet many of us know very little about
this place.
The
overwhelming responsibilities of this world - and there are many
- often eclipse our thoughts about the next one. Heaven seems
remote and irrelevant to our existence.
Yet we
all yearn for a better world, especially when we experience
disappointments: a bad report from the doctor, the betrayal of a
friend, the breakup of an intimate relationship, financial
hardship, or the death of a loved one. At those times we want to
believe - we have to believe - that there is a better place.
Over and
over in the Bible, God promises you that there is a better place
... that His people will live with Him forever in a place where
perfect righteousness dwells. Heaven is a real place.
Today, I
want to help elevate your thinking from earthbound concerns to
the hope of heaven and give you a tool to help the grieving,
discouraged, and hurting loved ones in your life.

It is my
joy to offer you my brand-new book, Encouragement from a Place
Called Heaven: Words of Hope About Your Eternal Home, as a
thank-you for your support of Pathway to Victory.

It's a
tremendous resource to help you, or a loved one, find joy and
hope in the promise of heaven.
Along
with the book, I will also send you "What 7 World Religions Teach
About Heaven." It's a comparison resource showing what Christians
believe about heaven compared to the beliefs of other major
religions: Judaism, Islam, Buddhism, Hinduism, Mormonism, and
Jehovah's Witness.
Your gift
to the ministry of Pathway to Victory can be made here:
https://ptv.org/donate/encouragement-from-a-place-called-heaven-generous-gift/
The more
we understand and set our minds on heaven, the more our
perspective of earth will change, impacting our lives and the
lives of those around us.
I pray
these two resources will bless you.

Dr.
Robert Jeffress
Senior
Pastor, First Baptist Dallas

subject: Americans find this “British Bulldog”captivating
body:
You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, “Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,” on DVD.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zvbmhmolud3japuvavp7un49nmvpoi13abahd5b8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h60o32c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2d9ieuqfbdbie4rrcdljkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbqj1p9nmljr7d1h61ojcctmepg7dctmm5o78cjn6kqn2ttmedp7atr0spjb2tbnmv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6hj38o5jc1jrcoj66pgb4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp2bs)
This sponsored message from Deroy Murdock is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2ze21p952iai3bii12iic66n8ne7qb7ko03o7aoj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h60o32c3h2bs) Dear Fellow American, You can now own one of Hillsdale College’s most popular online courses, **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship,”** on DVD. Thousands of people have enjoyed this in-depth course online since its release, _**and now you can add it to your personal library or give it as a gift.**_ In recent years Winston Churchill, who is best known for his leadership during World War II, has been portrayed in numerous films and television shows, proving without a doubt that Americans find the “British Bulldog” captivating. The reasons for this sustained interest in Churchill are profound. No statesman has better diagnosed the threat of modern technology; no statesman has spoken more effectively in opposition to socialism; and, no statesman has displayed more courage in the face of tyranny. It should come as little surprise that so many “academics” and activists are working to smear his legacy, which makes studying a true account of Churchill’s accomplishments more important than ever. **For precisely this reason, I am so excited to offer you this powerful DVD set:** **_[https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zmvr7kijna32os2ds20fvrlica0fnm1rltshu4t8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h60o32c3h2bs)_** As a student of Dr. Arnn myself, I know that his lectures on Churchill will teach you more about this subject than any of the many books and videos available to you, and they will reveal profound lessons that can be applied to the urgent problems of today. [](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zj3mmplim2c1q26psegu6hf76uj6n0h3mslkf9ug_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h60o32c3h2bs) Only a limited number of these DVD sets are available, so I hope you’ll take this opportunity to add it to your personal library or give it as a gift—before they’re gone. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“Winston Churchill and Statesmanship** ” on DVD: _[**https://secure.hillsdale.edu/winston-churchill-dvd-offer/**](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zdolvs74av58jc674kbehv5dq7ttrs8865p06hk8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h60o32c3h2bs)_ You’ll undoubtedly enjoy this close study of Churchill’s words and deeds.

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ‘09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College |

This is a MASSIVE number of tooth-and-nail races. With so much on the line, we can’t afford to lose a single incumbent. 2. As of last year, 41% of Americans view socialism positively. That’s a dangerously high number - and it’s only climbing. Democrats have a clear path to take America full-on socialists, and taking back the House is the only way to stop them. Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zce42n0uoi3qlf3mgdo8dm3esmcqn0ujv83o51gg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h60o32cth2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. But not only does she have the GOP Establishment in her back pocket – she also has the Democrats – since she votes with Biden and Chuck Schumer! So she’s hoping she can just buy this election with dark money given to her by both sides of the aisle... And unfortunately, she might get away with it if we fail to reach our end-of-month goal. And right now, we’re still $4,750 behind. | | | | | | While Liberal Lisa Murkowski might have unlimited funds, I have what actually matters – conservative values, good ideas, and loyalty to the American taxpayer. Money can’t buy common sense, courage, or loyalty to the people they’re supposed to represent. For far too long, politicians have been hiding behind their money and their power... and they think they’re untouchable. They truly are elitist to the core. I’m not running to get rich or to gain power. I’m here to defend American values, the Constitution, and the American people. I hope you can see that. **Fellow activist, our Commonwealth is at a point of crisis due to underrepresentation.**
I’m Pennsylvania born and raised. I’ve witnessed first-hand the immense changes our Commonwealth’s demographics have undergone in the last few decades. Our Black, brown, Latinx, and Asian communities are driving our growth. _That’s just a fact._ Unfortunately, these communities remain _vastly_ underrepresented in our state government.
I believe every single Pennsylvanian deserves to feel empowered and heard by their government. That’s why I started the New Pennsylvania Project, and it’s why I’m asking for your help. **We only have a few hours left to hit our goal for the month.** [**Can you donate today to make sure we have the resources to mobilize communities of color and the youth across the Commonwealth during this essential election year?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45956142/348210160/-1015736156?refcode=EM_FR_220531EOM3_EOM_KK_90DO_4_NG_N_L2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVjAwMS8xLzkwOTIwIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjA4MjI1Y2ZiLTBmZTEtZWMxMS1iNjU2LTI4MTg3OGI4NTExMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lbQ_Ru6wYFu4_rTwl9sRqbd0aARZ4A5H8nZE_DCZ6TA=)

clean_body: Fixing our underrepresentation crisis = Fellow activist, our Commonwealth is at a point of crisis due to underrepresentation. I’m Pennsylvania born and raised. I’ve witnessed first-hand the immense changes our Commonwealth’s demographics have undergone in the last few decades. Our Black, brown, Latinx, and Asian communities are driving our growth. That’s just a fact. Unfortunately, these communities remain vastly underrepresented in our state government. I believe every single Pennsylvanian deserves to feel empowered and heard by their government. That’s why I started the New Pennsylvania Project, and it’s why I’m asking for your help. We only have a few hours left to hit our goal for the month. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately. = = = = = We’re in the streets day and night registering voters, getting people to the polls, and expanding voting rights. It isn’t easy work, but we have an obligation to pursue fairness even when it is difficult. In our battleground state, every vote really does count — as we are still awaiting official results for the U.S. Senate race on the Republican side. With years of experience under our belt, we know how to mobilize voters in the Commonwealth. We know how to stretch a budget to ensure every dollar we raise makes as big an impact as possible. = = In defense of our democracy, Kadida Kenner Founding Executive Director The New Pennsylvania Project = The New Pennsylvania Project was founded in May 2021 to expand Pennsylvania’s electorate, so it reflects the Commonwealth’s demographically changing population. name: Bill de Blasio
subject: Heart and soul
body:
For the next 84 days, I am going to campaign the way I intend to serve:
# [](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/150?t=1&akid=156%2E39519%2EUCrm6n)

Friends -
For the next 84 days, I am going to campaign the way I intend to serve:
With my entire heart and soul.
I am going to be out there — at subways and street fairs, knocking on doors, talking to people — humbly working for every single vote.
Some conversations will be easy. There are a lot of families who are better off because of universal pre-K, 3-K, and believe the vaccine mandates we put in place while I was mayor saved lives.
Some conversations may be more difficult, and that’s fine too.
Because ultimately, this campaign and the job of a representative in Congress is about listening to people and hearing what they feel, and then getting to work for them — whether it’s an individual family, a block, or an entire neighborhood.
Now I don’t expect you to be out there with me every single day. But I do need your help today. Because tonight’s May fundraising deadline is our first test and we need lots of donations before it ends.
So please:
[**Can you make a contribution — $5, $10, or any amount you can afford? It all adds up when we’re all chipping in and what we raise isn’t as important as the number of people donating to make it happen.](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/191?refcode=em-220531&t=2&akid=156%2E39519%2EUCrm6n)**
**[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.billdeblasio.com/go/191?refcode=em-220531&t=3&akid=156%2E39519%2EUCrm6n)**
If you can make that donation to ensure we have the resources we need to win, you can count on me to put in the work needed to get it done.
In solidarity,
Bill de Blasio

De Blasio for Congress
This email was sent to **dpwillis67@gmail.com**. If you need to, [**unsubscribe here**](https://act.billdeblasio.com/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe?t=4&akid=156%2E39519%2EUCrm6n). We hope you'll stay, because emails are such an important part of how we organize.

Peter, all
across Kentucky our movement to replace Rand Paul is rising up. We made
history when Charles won his primary and became the first Black candidate
to represent a major party statewide.

It’s clear that Kentucky is hungry for the bold, progressive vision that
Charles Booker is fighting for this election. From passing Medicare for
All to electing a Senator that understands firsthand what it’s like to
stand in the unemployment line — we have a historic opportunity to enact
meaningful change and center everyday people in our politics.

But now it’s critical we continue growing this momentum leading up to the
election and make sure we have the grassroots power to overcome Rand’s
dark money.

Your $2.40 donation today will help us:

* Train our organizers so we can effectively (and directly) reach out to
voters in all 120 counties of our Commonwealth
* Hire key campaign staff to expand our capacity
* Acquire digital tools so we can get our message out to millions of
Kentuckians
* Reimburse our organizers for gas as they travel across Kentucky
* Organize phone call and texting banks to talk to voters

Unlike Rand Paul, we don’t accept a single cent from corporate PACs or

body:
Liberals can’t keep their story straight about Critical Race Theory. They insist, “Critical Race Theory isn’t being taugh
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zicq9dcign1lufdqvchbji22bl0oolath24r0eig_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbrr7d9kciqm4sr1climcp75m6om0otle3i37clk65hratdimtgnapr5e3ieccb76v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjbc37maqmcdb4mdiefc5lclp238h1e8he4933clgm0oj5c5i69oh5u)
This is your opportunity to get conservatives on to school boards -- and Critical Race Theory out of classrooms.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zesgiqo21439h0itim64f5e6v78l5cbclt5rlbv0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h6aob4cjh2bs) Fellow Conservative, Liberals can’t keep their story straight about Critical Race Theory. They insist, “Critical Race Theory isn’t being taught in schools!” Critical Race Theory most certainly _is_ being taught in the schools. Parents all over the country have noticed _and they’re not happy about it_. But the instruction in anti-whiteness is part of a much larger plan to **“fundamentally transform”** our country. (Remember Barack Obama?). These steely-eye zealots have taken over our schools, our universities, our media, our corporations -- even our sports leagues for Pete’s sake! Why might that be? **_Because they want your kids._** This is your opportunity to get conservatives **_on_** to school boards -- and Critical Race Theory **_out_** of classrooms. [ **I want to stop Critical Race Theory** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4nd8oq38ma3l3jnim33ct6h6ed56r7tu0fp1gi8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h6aob4cjh2bs) It’s called the **School Board Campaign Training**. It’s run by the best conservative training group in America called the **Leadership Institute**. With this new training, the Leadership Institute brings savvy, experienced campaign experts and teachers to teach conservatives how to overcome the odds and win those school board races. **What a great way to help thousands of “Davids” beat the odds -- and the left!** Morton and his staff started this newest training online. Because in these COVID-crazy times, it’s still not easy to bring together big crowds in restrictive, liberal-run states. By having most of these trainings online, the Leadership Institute can reach much, much larger audiences (maybe you shouldn’t have shut down the country, liberals!). Experienced LI trainers can now get to any potential conservative school board candidate **_anywhere, anytime_**. The LI team put together eleven hours of nuts-and-bolts videos detailing everything conservatives need to need to know to beat back the left and save kids from brainwashing **in hating America**. **Conservatives who take the course learn how to:**
* Plan a winning campaign.
* Design and run a successful Get-Out-the-Vote operation.
* Craft a compelling message.
* Handle scrutiny from their opponent and the media.
* And much more.

To get a conservative parent through the online training costs $50 -- and to send someone through the in-person version costs $100. The folks at LI don’t play around. They aim to train as many conservatives as possible. But for this month, their goal is to raise $20,000 -- to train 200 more conservatives online and 100 in-person. [**Will you donate $50 today to train someone online? Or give $100 to send a conservative through the in-person training?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zojvejh8jnvum2qh742qf5ef1aae0mcfq28h9ob0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h6aob4cjh2bs) [ **Yes, I'll help train one more conservative school board candidate** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zssphbbfpvgomkhn426243rdpesm3iscun8rm0fg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h6aob4cjh2bs) With many school board positions up for election this year, now’s the time to act. **Your gift by the end of this month** will train one more conservative how to run for their local school board -- and win. **HERE'S WHAT ONE conservative who took the training, Natalie from Colorado, had to say:** “After learning about Critical Race Theory last summer and seeing what is being taught in our schools, I’ve come to understand the damage caused for students and our country.

**I can no longer sit on the sidelines and wait for someone else to solve the problem.** It’s time to overhaul the public school system, and we must start locally.” **In its first few months, LI’s School Board Campaign Training has enrolled 1,700 conservatives.** [**Your gift of $50, $100, or more will help the Leadership Institute stop leftists from warping kids’ minds and ruining our country.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z59etlnk95u73d16e9eksndpvje5e659ijlnhlrg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h6aob4cjh2bs) Please don’t wait to [**make your tax-deductible contribution**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zcdn2qs4gt164fbmqvfm6cfmefukakgscfmiku5g_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h6aob4cjh2bs) to the Leadership Institute today. Thank you! Let’s Save America, Ann Coulter

You’ll drive the left nuts -- while you save America.** So what are you waiting for? [**Please give right away!**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zae5sfuiinbi7nc157drj9frtpvi1i7bdqjjk0m0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h6aob4cjh2bs) Thank you. body:

Today marks 23 weeks to Election Day and it also marks our end-of-month deadline!
Our team is working hard to make sure we reach our fundraising target by the end of the day, and every contribution — no matter how big or small — helps.
If you can contribute, we’d really appreciate it! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220531wu?refcode=lpfe220531wu_m]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220531wu?refcode=lpfe220531wu_m]
We know many are still reeling from the shooting at Robb Elementary in Uvalde. We are, too.
Mass shootings have become an all-too-often occurrence in our country. Every time another happens, it’s a tragic reminder that our work together is vital and urgent. The way forward is electing leaders who will advocate for common-sense gun safety reforms.
That’s Lizzie. She’s advocated for solutions to gun violence since before entering Congress. In office, she’s fighting for stronger background checks and regulations on devices that convert guns into high-capacity weapons that are more dangerous and deadly.
Lizzie’s work on gun violence has been recognized with endorsements from the Brady Campaign and Giffords and the 2022 Moms Demand Action Gun Sense Candidate distinction.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220531wu?refcode=lpfe220531wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220531wu?refcode=lpfe220531wu_m]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220531wu?refcode=lpfe220531wu_m [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lpfe220531wu?refcode=lpfe220531wu_m]
We’re so proud to work with a principled leader who always stands up for what’s right. Lizzie won’t let up on this issue until Texans get the change they’re demanding.
Last week, Lizzie was part of a Community Conversation on Public Safety and Hate Crimes.
“People across our community and across the country are concerned about safety in our communities and the developments we’ve seen in recent years. We’ve seen an alarming rise in crime generally and we’ve seen a really frightening rise in hate crimes specifically. We know these events are on the rise, but we also know that bigotry and hatred more broadly are on the rise again in our country.”
- Rep. Lizzie Fletcher
READ MORE [https://thetexan.news/congresswoman-fletcher-claims-hate-crime-on-the-rise-with-state-rep-wu-at-houston-town-hall/]
Lizzie and the other panelists discussed the importance of recognizing these hateful acts, reporting them, and addressing them head-on to keep our communities safe. Lizzie voted for the American Rescue Plan — which included funding for the One Safe Houston program and its efforts to combat hate crime — and the COVID-19 Hate Crimes Act, which specifically targets hate crimes against Asian Americans and Pacific Islanders.
The Texas primary runoff was last week and we have a great ticket for the general elections this November!
From races for governor and state legislature to our race for TX-07 and other critical House contests, there are important elections happening up and down the ballot this year that will have an impact on the future of our state and our country. We need everyone to stay involved from now until November to help elect leaders who will champion our values at every level of government.
Thanks for being a part of the team,
Team Lizzie

east side of the street.* Look for all the Courtney Geels signs!*

name: John Lira
subject: Protecting the 2nd Amendment AND our families
body:
Peter,

In the aftermath of the shooting at Robb Elementary School last week, it’s important that we talk about how we got here so we can ensure that this tragedy does not repeat itself.

To do that, we need to talk about Tony Gonzales and GOP propaganda around gun safety reform.

Last year, TX-23 incumbent — who represents the victims of the shooting last week — Tony Gonzales voted against both the Bipartisan Background Checks Act and the Violence Against Women Act, as well as stripping Red Flag Laws from the NDAA.

Let that sink in. Tony Gonzales is okay with sticking to the GOP party line again by doing nothing to protect the lives of women and then bragging about it. This is typical GOP garbage.

[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-20220531?refcode=20220531]

If we had common sense gun safety laws like these in place, we could have prevented guns falling into the hands of those who aim to commit violence, like the shooter in Uvalde.

Peter, I am not saying that Tony Gonzales is responsible for the deaths of those 21 people — but his vote against those reforms was a vote for gun ownership at any cost, for NRA mega donations, to uphold Republican lies at the cost of the lives of the people he represents.

Republican leaders like him try to tell us that the only way to protect our Second Amendment Rights is to oppose all gun safety reform measures.

I don’t accept that.

As a veteran and a gun owner myself, I understand the reasons to possess a firearm. But I also know that we can protect our right to bear arms while doing what it takes to protect our families and communities from being ripped apart by violence.

This is why I am running to represent TX-23.

Because the majority of Americans already support passing gun safety reforms to prevent gun violence, and we deserve to have representatives in Congress who will listen and take action on behalf of our communities.

If you agree that Texans deserve more and that it’s time to kick reps like Tony Gonzales who refuse to protect both our rights AND our communities out of Congress, will you make a donation to support this campaign? Let’s finally get TX-23 a representative who will put them first.

[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lira-em-20220531?refcode=20220531]

In solidarity,
John Lira

https://www.facebook.com/LiraforCongress [https://www.facebook.com/LiraforCongress] https://twitter.com/LiraforCongress [https://twitter.com/LiraforCongress]

John Lira for Congress
1721 WW White Rd, Suite 120
#8096
San Antonio, TX 78220
United States

| | | Kristi Noem and I have MANY differences of opinion on the right direction for South Dakota, but perhaps the most daylight you’ll find between us is on this: I believe South Dakota is OUR home.

What do I mean by this?

First things first, we have to get our home in order before we worry about someone else’s problem (such as her attempts to make our state more appealing to Blue-State refugees).

OUR people can’t afford rising property taxes.

OUR people aren’t safe in the streets of our cities.

OUR schools and children are struggling for lack of funds.

We all want to see our state prosper. We all desire a strong economy and for good businesses to set up shop here. But Noem has her eyes on a more distant prize – on being elected President, not on solving local problems.

As we approach the primary election day, ask yourself this: **which Republican candidate is truly South Dakota First? **

I was born here. My children are here. My grandchildren are here. South Dakota is MY home just as it is yours, and together you and I are invested in the future of our state.

_**Vote for Steve Haugaard on June 7th and you know you’re voting to preserve and heal OUR home.**_

South Dakota First!
---
|
\- Steve Haugaard

_Republican Candidate for Governor _

Friend -- Last Tuesday, we achieved what every pollster and pundit said was impossible: We got Georgia Secretary of State Brad Raffensperger more than 50% of the vote, which allowed him to avoid a daunting run-off. We can rest easy knowing that whoever wins this November, Trump won't have a hand-picked Secretary of State to rig Georgia for him in 2024. I'm thankful for you being part of this movement, and for everyone who has chipped in even a few dollars to our [Primary First](https://www.country1st.com/primaryfirst?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=brad_upset_nd&n=2) strategy, which was absolutely the key to the greatest upset of the 2022 cycle thus far. ---
We now look ahead to our next big target races: Defeating Reps. Matt Gaetz and Lauren Boebert, and then working to defeat a slew of insurrectionists running up and down the ballot in Michigan.
And when the primary season is over, we'll be able to laser-focus on unrigging and strengthening our nation's voting systems so that someday, hopefully sooner than later, we don't need strategies like Primary First in order for Reasonable Americans to be represented by Reasonable Leaders.
That's the long-game to defeating toxic politics, but in the meantime, let's keep the momentum going and the victories coming!
Country First,
Adam

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. # **Vote For Change This Primary! **
** **
Let's face it, things are not going well in our country. Our government can't solve any problems.

Neither political party is truly committed to the American people. That's why I am INDEPENDENT. I put people above corporations, and believe that the government should GET THINGS DONE, like stopping gun violence.

I am standing up to the two parties and fighting for change. I’m counting on people like you to help me continue that fight. Please **Vote** **Adam Schindler for Congress** in the June 7 primary and LET'S CHANGE THE FORMULA in Washington. For more information about Adam, visit [www.schindler4congress.com](https://schindler4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=26f52603239d4d900dd89d343&id=934897c45e&e=e1c04ba93f). **If you haven't voted yet, we've included information below on how and where to turn in your ballot.**
Kindly,

Adam Schindler, Ph.D.

| All active registered California voters have been sent a vote-by-mail ballot with a prepaid, first-class postage return envelope for the June 7, 2022, Primary Election. You have multiple safe, secure, and reliable options for returning your ballot. Whichever option you choose to return your ballot, _remember to sign the envelope in the space provided_.
* **Mail** – No stamp is required to return your ballot through the US Postal Service. Make sure your ballot is postmarked by June 7, 2022, and arrives no later than 7 days after the election.
* **Drop box** – Counties offer secure drop boxes to return your ballot. Make sure your ballot is deposited by 8:00 p.m. on June 7, 2022.
* **In person** – You can return your ballot to a polling place, vote center, or your county elections office by 8:00 p.m. on June 7, 2022. One or more voting locations in many counties will be open prior to Election Day. Voting locations will offer voter registration, replacement ballots, accessible voting machines, and language assistance.

Sign up at [WheresMyBallot.sos.ca.gov](https://schindler4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=26f52603239d4d900dd89d343&id=406cab740c&e=e1c04ba93f) to receive updates on your vote-by-mail ballot via text (SMS), email, or voice call. Remember to make a plan to vote! For more information on casting your ballot, go to [vote.ca.gov](https://schindler4congress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=26f52603239d4d900dd89d343&id=329324d84d&e=e1c04ba93f).

| | Dear Friend,

Imagine running from the home you love, frightened for your life, surrounded by the stench of smoke and ear-splitting explosions. This is the reality for more than 6 million people who have fled to neighboring countries since the conflict in Ukraine began.

Millions more are displaced within Ukraine, where hotspots of food shortages and disrupted health and education systems are wreaking havoc on children and parents alike. The need is desperate for food, shelter, protection from exploitation and violence, and more. [You can bring hope](http://click1.srnemail.com/tpwpvcddvtbkttrdkbbglkjtsvkmcsstzcgrszbhwbpjhh_jbqmmttjtrjnwbmvtsjbqss.html) to displaced and refugee families with a gift today.

| | World Vision is actively supporting refugees and host communities in Romania and Moldova, as well as families displaced within Ukraine and in Georgia, providing essentials like food, shelter, protection against trafficking, and so much more -- all made possible by the help of caring people like you. Nearly 100,000 people have already been served, but the need is great. If you're able, [please give today](http://click1.srnemail.com/lqwhjnffjldrllcfrddymrqlsjrwnsslknycskdgzdhqgn_jbqmmttjtrjnwbmvtsjbqss.html).

Additional efforts currently being planned and rolled out include:
• Hot school lunches and school kits for teen refugees in Moldova
• Child-Friendly Spaces for kids transitioning through refugee centers
• Food kits and hot meals near border crossings

Thank you for your prayers for the safety and protection of children. And thank you for joining us in serving as the hands and feet of Jesus for those facing loss, pain, and uncertainty.

name: Giffords
subject: There will be votes SOON
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
One way or another, it looks as if the Senate will soon vote on gun safety legislation.
#

Friends -
One way or another, it looks as if the Senate will soon vote on gun safety legislation.
We don’t yet know what the bill, or bills, will be, but we do know this: there are going to be a number of Republicans--backed by the NRA--who will be opposed to anything that comes to the floor.
If history is any guide, the debate will be contentious and costly.
So we’ll need your help.
The truth is, the overwhelming majority of Americans want action on this issue. And our job is to spread the word about the vote, and to hold those who oppose commonsense bills that will make us safer accountable.
Because either we are going to have a Congress that prioritizes our communities over the profits of gun manufacturers, or we are going to have to elect new members of Congress who will.
And in both instances, Gabby can’t do it alone.

This seat has been rated as one of the most likely to flip by CNN, but only if Tim has the resources to pull ahead in this neck-and-neck race.

clean_body: Friend, To protect Americans' constitutional right to choose, we have to maintain and expand our pro-choice Senate majority. In Ohio, Democrat Rep. Tim Ryan is running against a right-wing extremist for Senator Portman's open seat. How extreme? His opponent – JD Vance – once described pregnancy from rape as "inconvenient." This seat has been rated as one of the most likely to flip by CNN, but only if Tim has the resources to pull ahead in this neck-and-neck race. Will you chip in $10 or more right now, so we can rush an urgent donation to Tim's campaign ahead of the May end-of-month fundraising deadline? On top of his anti-choice comments, JD Vance is the chosen candidate of Donald Trump. That should tell you all you need to know about this candidate. Meanwhile, Tim was raised by a single mom near Youngstown, Ohio. He watched firsthand as his family members lost their jobs when steel mills closed. While serving in Congress, he's fought hard to keep good jobs here in the United States, raise wages, and strengthen Social Security and Medicare. Now, he's ready to take that fight to the Senate. The polls are showing that Tim is up against Vance by a single point, but we need to make sure that he can maintain his lead. As corporate billionaires pour millions of dollars of dark money into this race, let's make it clear that our Green Mountain PAC community is behind Tim. Please, chip in $10 or more right now, so we can rush an urgent donation to Tim's campaign ahead of the May end-of-month fundraising deadline. Thank you. Sincerely, Patrick Leahy U.S. Senator CONTRIBUTE NOW »

Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. [**Would you be willing to share your thoughts in this brief 8 question survey?**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi03imihna4773oqmv02lh7fl91l0mb5p1dtada0_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h69o34c3h2bs) By doing so, you will help The Heritage Foundation understand what people like you think—and use your answers to fight back against the Biden administration’s radical anti-energy agenda. The survey should only take a few minutes of your time, but your opinion is incredibly valuable. **You can get started right now using this secure link:[https://secured.heritage.org/energy-independence-survey/](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6f8q65r3j75mj8n5kjsj14rs8j8spu8pl2p55sg_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h69o34c3h2bs)** Thank you so much for your time. body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?”
[View this message in your browser](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2h0ori30tle17f4ljjetvc35usp5sutc4i76jmg_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkir39tdkmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbom2ormcpprepr3mlijcp3462r36shic4oefdhnmcp6dd3mclo6ct72epo64ddn6v970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjbc37maomct34mdgmfc5lclp238h1e8he4933clgm0oj4s1i64oh5u)
| | | This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zatumnvm0itofunummlsln5urr6iuvrmlt5m9lj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h69o34c9h2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z5t7l69dnnam0dk6s3lbnltgv8k5e8kb3g337vag_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h69o34c9h2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1637h588rvngbklkd60h40ru48kj2d8v2c0hiho_rp22sh2s8i66pb1c1h69o34c9h2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | | **Amanda Makki receives endorsements from four distinguished veterans on Memorial Day**
Hi Friend!

We want to start by thanking all of our veterans and active duty servicemen and women. It was a great honor to be at Bay Pines National Cemetery in St. Petersburg where the community came together to place 31,000 American flags on the gravesites of our fallen heroes.

_The_ _Tampa Bay Times_ highlighted a photo of the widow of former Congressman Bill Young and Amanda Makki after the flags were laid _. _Thank you to all of our volunteers who came out to help.

Major General Randall L. West USMC (Ret) delivered the keynote address at the C.W. Bill Young Bay Pines VA Medical Center Memorial Day service. Yesterday, Amanda announced his endorsement along with other distinguished veterans. **“ _Amanda Makki is the fighter we need in Washington to protect our conservative values. She has the qualities I look for in a leader and a sense of duty I can respect,” said _General Randall West_. “Amanda Makki has earned my endorsement through her hard work and dedication to our veterans, our military members, and our great country.”_**
---
|
---
Amanda Makki with General Randall L. West, Beverly Young, and others during the Memorial Day Service at C.W. Bill Young Bay Pines VA Medical Center.
| **Below, Colonel Bill Hammack USMC (Ret.) also announced his endorsement of Amanda Makki on Memorial Day.**

_**“I know Amanda Makki and I’ve experienced the deep respect she has for veterans first-hand,” said _Col. Bill Hammack._ “I have witnessed in her those rare qualities of leadership that will not only represent her constituents but foster her to positions of leadership in our Republic.”**_

---
|
---
Amanda Makki with Col. Bill Hammack USMC (Ret.).
| Major General David Scott (FMR) U.S. Air Force and Former U.S. Army General Counsel Steven Morello also endorsed Amanda Makki for Congress on this important day.

**“ _Amanda has the drive, experience, and energy to make an immediate impact in Congress,” said _General David Scott_. “There is no better candidate to represent conservatives in the Tampa Bay region.”_** **“ _Amanda Makki is an outstanding candidate for the U.S. Congress. Amanda was appointed to work with me during one of the most crucial times in American history,” wrote former _U.S. Army General Counsel Steven J. Morello_ in a statement. “Please join me in supporting Amanda Makki today, so that we can win back The House of Representatives and keep Nancy Pelosi from pushing the divisive and harmful Critical Race Theory on our brave men and women of the military.”_**

**This distinguished group joins several other veterans who have already announced their support for Amanda Makki including Belleair Shore Mayor Bob Schmidt, Pro-Veteran SEAL PAC, and Marine Corps General William Keyes (Ret.), respectively.**

Amanda described what an honor it is to have their collective endorsements on Memorial Day. **“ _Today is a day to honor the service and sacrifices of our military members and our veterans,” said Amanda Makki. “On this of all days, I am grateful beyond-measure to each of these distinguished veterans for their patriotism, continued concern for our country, and their careful decision to endorse me in the race for Congress in Florida’s 13th District.”_**
There has never been a more exciting time to get involved! Here are some ways you can support Amanda.

We are in need of volunteers to help remove flags at Bay Pines National Cemetery on June 4th at 9:00 a.m.
* [Join Team Makki as a volunteer!](mailto:Skylar@amandamakki.com?subject=I%20want%20to%20join%20Team%20Makki%20as%20a%20volunteer!)
* [RSVP for one of Amanda's upcoming events](https://amandamakki.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e08b08a89872d093efe5d84d&id=e8739a7944&e=c2296cffff)
* [Make a contribution to support Amanda's efforts](https://amandamakki.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0e08b08a89872d093efe5d84d&id=2e28ea4f0d&e=c2296cffff)

Thank you for your support and we'll see you along the campaign trail!

Gratefully,

Team Makki
P. S. If you’d like to host a meet and greet for Amanda, please e-mail Skylar@amandamakki.com

clean_body: Four distinguished veterans endorsed Amanda Makki on Memorial Day | | | | | mailto:Skylar@AmandaMakki.com?subject=Tell%20Amanda%20I'll%20see%20her%20at%20Bogota%20Kitchen! "RSVP NOW!" | | | | Amanda Makki receives endorsements from four distinguished veterans on Memorial Day Hi Friend! We want to start by thanking all of our veterans and active duty servicemen and women. It was a great honor to be at Bay Pines National Cemetery in St. Petersburg where the community came together to place 31,000 American flags on the gravesites of our fallen heroes. The Tampa Bay Times highlighted a photo of the widow of former Congressman Bill Young and Amanda Makki after the flags were laid . Thank you to all of our volunteers who came out to help. Major General Randall L. West USMC (Ret) delivered the keynote address at the C.W. Bill Young Bay Pines VA Medical Center Memorial Day service. Yesterday, Amanda announced his endorsement along with other distinguished veterans. “ Amanda Makki is the fighter we need in Washington to protect our conservative values. She has the qualities I look for in a leader and a sense of duty I can respect,” said General Randall West. “Amanda Makki has earned my endorsement through her hard work and dedication to our veterans, our military members, and our great country.” | Amanda Makki with General Randall L. West, Beverly Young, and others during the Memorial Day Service at C.W. Bill Young Bay Pines VA Medical Center. | Below, Colonel Bill Hammack USMC (Ret.) also announced his endorsement of Amanda Makki on Memorial Day. “I know Amanda Makki and I’ve experienced the deep respect she has for veterans first-hand,” said Col. Bill Hammack. “I have witnessed in her those rare qualities of leadership that will not only represent her constituents but foster her to positions of leadership in our Republic.” | Amanda Makki with Col. Bill Hammack USMC (Ret.). | Major General David Scott (FMR) U.S. Air Force and Former U.S. Army General Counsel Steven Morello also endorsed Amanda Makki for Congress on this important day. “ Amanda has the drive, experience, and energy to make an immediate impact in Congress,” said General David Scott. “There is no better candidate to represent conservatives in the Tampa Bay region.” “ Amanda Makki is an outstanding candidate for the U.S. Congress. Amanda was appointed to work with me during one of the most crucial times in American history,” wrote former U.S. Army General Counsel Steven J. Morello in a statement. “Please join me in supporting Amanda Makki today, so that we can win back The House of Representatives and keep Nancy Pelosi from pushing the divisive and harmful Critical Race Theory on our brave men and women of the military.” This distinguished group joins several other veterans who have already announced their support for Amanda Makki including Belleair Shore Mayor Bob Schmidt, Pro-Veteran SEAL PAC, and Marine Corps General William Keyes (Ret.), respectively. Amanda described what an honor it is to have their collective endorsements on Memorial Day. “ Today is a day to honor the service and sacrifices of our military members and our veterans,” said Amanda Makki. “On this of all days, I am grateful beyond-measure to each of these distinguished veterans for their patriotism, continued concern for our country, and their careful decision to endorse me in the race for Congress in Florida’s 13th District.” There has never been a more exciting time to get involved! body:
how you can take action in Indiana

|
---
Folks, It was only a few short weeks ago when a draft opinion by the U.S. Supreme Court was leaked. That draft will overturn _Roe v. Wade_ if it becomes a formal ruling. In that time, we’ve seen the country come together to organize and take action to help protect access to safe and legal abortions. It’s no secret that only about **17%** of Hoosiers believe abortion should be criminalized under all circumstances. And, about **56%** of Hoosiers have opposed extreme abortion measures like Mike Pence’s 2016 law — _which forced women to have a funeral for stillborn babies._ Let’s be clear — ending Roe does not end abortions. It ends access to safe and legal abortions – (_the law of the land for nearly 50 years_) — especially for vulnerable communities across Indiana and nationwide. **And make no mistake, Democrats do not root for abortion.** We understand that it is sometimes a necessary procedure. If a woman is raped, she should not be forced to have her rapist’s baby. If a girl experiences incest, she should not be forced to have a child. And, if a woman’s life is on the line — she should not be forced to die. **We know that healthcare decisions should be made with a doctor or health care professional – not politicians.[Sign our petition if you agree.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45961792/348238037/-22632011?refcode=idp-em-220531-roe&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMDk5OWI5OS0yNGUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=oA6E7u8aMi0YeFgiwYtjGBzuFn3ovnEgIWnWZqCALHM=&emci=ac82286f-16e1-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=b0999b99-24e1-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ceid=4925535)** There was already so much at stake in the midterm elections this November – and now the stakes got even higher. name: Jenny Jang
subject: Our Asian American Pacific Islander Month highlights!
body:
| | Hey Friend, **Once again, Happy Asian American Pacific Islander Month!** During the month of May, we made it our mission to shine a light on AAPI voters, voices, and the issues that matter to us. We did just that — and then some. **As AAPI month comes to a close, I want to celebrate our impact with you.**
* **Nearly 2,000 people signed our petition** urging Congress to pave a pathway to citizenship for the immigrant community because we believe everyone deserves to live without fearing separation from their families and livelihoods.
* We scheduled over **100 volunteer shifts** for our AAPI advocacy and relational organizing events.
* **Drew Afualo** , best known as TikTok’s iconic “Crusader of Women” and a proud Samoan content creator, stopped by our volunteer event to say hello!
* We engaged in innovative organizing tactics using messaging platforms like **WhatsApp, KakaoTalk, and WeChat** to connect with members of our community where they’re at.
* During our social media week of action, we ramped up our content on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok to promote the power of AAPI voters and activists — **reaching an audience of 32,489. **
* We launched a **sticker giveaway** , so our community could show off our AAPI pride!

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45962183/348239923/-1227335829?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjY3ZmFhNy0yNGUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FzE-hAy3Wc0GAq26FkVwKT_PeFvayEhLNQzNKWK5EUM=&emci=4649b657-e2dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=6f67faa7-24e1-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ceid=6787172) [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/45962184/348239924/-1227335829?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNTkcvMS81NjE1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjY3ZmFhNy0yNGUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=FzE-hAy3Wc0GAq26FkVwKT_PeFvayEhLNQzNKWK5EUM=&emci=4649b657-e2dd-ec11-b656-281878b85110&emdi=6f67faa7-24e1-ec11-b656-281878b85110&ceid=6787172) **I want to stress that our organizing doesn’t stop at the end of this month — not today, not until we see the change we deserve.** If this month showed us anything, it’s that we are taking control of our future and we’re doing it together. As we gear up for the 2022 midterms, this is a critical moment to galvanize the rising political consciousness of the AAPI community. clean_body: | | Hey Friend, Once again, Happy Asian American Pacific Islander Month! During the month of May, we made it our mission to shine a light on AAPI voters, voices, and the issues that matter to us. We did just that — and then some. As AAPI month comes to a close, I want to celebrate our impact with you. Nearly 2,000 people signed our petition urging Congress to pave a pathway to citizenship for the immigrant community because we believe everyone deserves to live without fearing separation from their families and livelihoods. We scheduled over 100 volunteer shifts for our AAPI advocacy and relational organizing events. Drew Afualo , best known as TikTok’s iconic “Crusader of Women” and a proud Samoan content creator, stopped by our volunteer event to say hello! We engaged in innovative organizing tactics using messaging platforms like WhatsApp, KakaoTalk, and WeChat to connect with members of our community where they’re at. During our social media week of action, we ramped up our content on Instagram, Twitter, and TikTok to promote the power of AAPI voters and activists — reaching an audience of 32,489. We launched a sticker giveaway , so our community could show off our AAPI pride! I want to stress that our organizing doesn’t stop at the end of this month — not today, not until we see the change we deserve. If this month showed us anything, it’s that we are taking control of our future and we’re doing it together. As we gear up for the 2022 midterms, this is a critical moment to galvanize the rising political consciousness of the AAPI community. We’re mobilizing young people invested in fortifying immigrant rights, economic justice, ballot access, health access, language access, and more. Will you join us? | "CTA Button" Yours truly, Jenny Jang Digital Project Manager NextGen America | NextGen America 268 Bush St. #2919 San Francisco CA 94104-3503 This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com | =

body:
I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running for U.S. Senate
| | |
---
Peter, the past several weeks since launching my campaign for Senate have been a whirlwind, to say the least. I finally have a free moment, so I wanted to take a second to properly introduce myself and tell you a bit more about why I'm running for Senate.
I've spent my whole life in Missouri. As a young girl growing up here, I watched my parents live the American Dream.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45962538/348241355/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk34-fr-30d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTVhZDY1NS0yNWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CfzYcN5KRFOVwLri35xoATJLbDCB8ndRJzJmHYS-yu4=)
At a young age, my parents taught me that “to whom much is given, much is expected.” That sense of duty to help others is what drove me to choose a life of service.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45962540/348241357/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk34-fr-30d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTVhZDY1NS0yNWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CfzYcN5KRFOVwLri35xoATJLbDCB8ndRJzJmHYS-yu4=)
When I was a kid, I dreamed of becoming a nurse. To me, nurses were the real superheroes. They took care of people and saved lives. That’s what I wanted to do – so I set out to make it happen.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45962542/348241359/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk34-fr-30d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTVhZDY1NS0yNWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CfzYcN5KRFOVwLri35xoATJLbDCB8ndRJzJmHYS-yu4=)
As a young woman, I fulfilled my dream of becoming a nurse. Right after nursing school, I worked at a hospital and cared for children, seniors, people who relied on Medicare and Medicaid for their healthcare, and folks from all walks of life.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45962544/348241361/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk34-fr-30d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTVhZDY1NS0yNWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CfzYcN5KRFOVwLri35xoATJLbDCB8ndRJzJmHYS-yu4=)
During my time working in a hospital, I saw the importance of quality healthcare firsthand. As a nurse, I believe that every person deserves access to the very best medical care, and as a parent, I believe that everyone should have access to contraception and abortion care – full stop.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45962546/348241363/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk34-fr-30d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTVhZDY1NS0yNWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CfzYcN5KRFOVwLri35xoATJLbDCB8ndRJzJmHYS-yu4=)
I’ve spent my life giving back and helping others, and now I’m running for U.S. Senate because we need a nurse's heart in Washington.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45962548/348241365/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk34-fr-30d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTVhZDY1NS0yNWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CfzYcN5KRFOVwLri35xoATJLbDCB8ndRJzJmHYS-yu4=)
**To truly solve problems, we need leadership that puts politics aside and puts people first – and that’s exactly what I’m ready to do as your next U.S. senator.** But I can't run a winning campaign without your support.
My team is trying to reach our very first end-of-month goal before our 11:59 p.m. deadline tonight. **I'd really hate to fall short here – and we just need to bring in another $10,748 – so I have to ask you: **[Please, can you make a donation of $5, or whatever you can spare tonight, to help me bring compassion, honesty, and respect back to Washington?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45962550/348241367/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk34-fr-30d&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MTVhZDY1NS0yNWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=CfzYcN5KRFOVwLri35xoATJLbDCB8ndRJzJmHYS-yu4=)

name: Aadland For Colorado
subject: Another businessman endorses Erik Aadland
body:
Also former county commissioner
| | | |

|

|
# Mesa County Commissioner Rick Enstrom
---
|
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
(May 31, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from businessman, conservationist, and former Mesa County Commissioner Rick Enstrom.

Rick Enstrom ran for, and won, Mesa County Commission at the of age 24 (at the time the youngest in Colorado history). Subsequently, he served on the Grand Junction Airport Authority, the Board of Social Services, the Community Action Agency and Mesa County Board of Health.

Following his term on the County Commission,
Enstrom purchased AirTime Records and Video and he and his family returned to Lakewood.

Enstrom currently serves as President of the Jefferson County Foothills Republicans.
| In a statement sent to the Aadland campaign, Enstrom said:
"It's my pleasure to endorse Erik Aadland for Congress. I've been part of the political and business communities in Colorado for most of my life, and as such I've seen many would-be leaders come and go. I'm proud to say that Erik is the real deal, both in his desire and his qualifications to serve Coloradans. Erik's experience encompasses the struggles and successes of leading teams all over the world in multiple contexts. He is well prepared, in the depth of his thought and of his character, for the challenges of representing his constituents with wisdom and integrity. I have no doubt that he will elevate the discourse in Washington while remaining true to Colorado and Constitutional values."
---
|
---
|
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
|
---
|
---
| "I'm deeply appreciative of Rick's endorsement. It's a true honor and a boost to all our supporters' confidence to know that a leader of his caliber and tenure, with experience in so many facets of business, politics, and life, has surveyed the field and recognized me as the best choice to represent our community. With the encouragement of constituents like Rick, I remain enthusiastically committed to bringing the hopes, dreams, and concerns of everyday Coloradans to Washington."
---

| |
---
|
---

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.
---
|
---
|
## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

clean_body: Also former county commissioner | | | | | | Mesa County Commissioner Rick Enstrom | | | | | ---|--- | (May 31, 2022) Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from businessman, conservationist, and former Mesa County Commissioner Rick Enstrom. Rick Enstrom ran for, and won, Mesa County Commission at the of age 24 (at the time the youngest in Colorado history). Subsequently, he served on the Grand Junction Airport Authority, the Board of Social Services, the Community Action Agency and Mesa County Board of Health. Following his term on the County Commission, Enstrom purchased AirTime Records and Video and he and his family returned to Lakewood. Enstrom currently serves as President of the Jefferson County Foothills Republicans. | In a statement sent to the Aadland campaign, Enstrom said: "It's my pleasure to endorse Erik Aadland for Congress. I've been part of the political and business communities in Colorado for most of my life, and as such I've seen many would-be leaders come and go. I'm proud to say that Erik is the real deal, both in his desire and his qualifications to serve Coloradans. Erik's experience encompasses the struggles and successes of leading teams all over the world in multiple contexts. He is well prepared, in the depth of his thought and of his character, for the challenges of representing his constituents with wisdom and integrity. I have no doubt that he will elevate the discourse in Washington while remaining true to Colorado and Constitutional values." | | | Erik's Remarks | | | "I'm deeply appreciative of Rick's endorsement. It's a true honor and a boost to all our supporters' confidence to know that a leader of his caliber and tenure, with experience in so many facets of business, politics, and life, has surveyed the field and recognized me as the best choice to represent our community. With the encouragement of constituents like Rick, I remain enthusiastically committed to bringing the hopes, dreams, and concerns of everyday Coloradans to Washington." | | | | | == | | | About Erik | | | Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children. | | About Aadland For Congress | | | Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professional people, friends and neighbors. You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. subject: Fundamentally different than other campaigns
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
This is what makes us different.
#
Derek,
I know I’ve said this before, but it’s so important I’m going to say it again: Our campaign is so fundamentally different from the others.
What makes us so different?
**No icky, dirty money here, thanks very much! 🙅🏻♀️**
We're running a clean and honest Democratic campaign. That means our campaign will never accept dirty corporate PAC money. No million-dollar Wall Street checks. And definitely no money from Big Oil.
We fund our campaign this way because we believe it’s the only right way. Because when we say we're people-powered, we really mean it.
Derek, my family and I are just so deeply grateful for all of this, and it’s why I’m asking today:
[**Can you please make your first donation right now to help us hit our ambitious end-of-month goal? If enough folks chip in through our emails, ads, and texts, we can raise $3 million — a number that reflects the power of our grassroots movement.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220531-1?refcode=em20220531-6054&refcode2=6054_434096_pICTeM&akid=6054%2E434096%2EpICTeM)
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220531-1?refcode=em20220531-6054&refcode2=6054_434096_pICTeM&akid=6054%2E434096%2EpICTeM)**
And if you can’t donate, remember that even just reading this email makes you a part of this team! Sharing us with your family, friends and neighbors... it’s all appreciated!
We hope being a part of this campaign makes you proud.
With love,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)
P.S. Loving that João is on a low-sodium regimen which means I don’t have to share any goodies with him. Thanks to Senator Gary Peters for the sweet surprise *for me*

****That didn’t stop my opponent or Nancy Pelosi from trying to overturn the results of my race and undermine me at every turn. **_ _ I decided that day that I never wanted what happened to me to happen to another candidate again, I was going to lead on reforming, securing, and auditing our election system. _ _ That means implementing common-sense reforms such as: _ _

name: Greg Stamps
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.readactnews.)
---
| | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://trk.readactnews.-ulyYV6Q)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://trk.readactnews.-I0Un0nDg)**[](http://trk.readactnews._mtZBXXUSC2qIQ), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. **[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://trk.readactnews.-q-w)** Thanks, Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University
---
_With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research organization that seeks to improve the human condition by advancing ideas that promote economic prosperity, national security, and democratic governance. Friend,

We're officially **one week** from the June 7th primary election in our campaign to unseat GOP Leader Kevin McCarthy. We've come a long way, and with Election Day coming up, I wanted to take a moment to remind you why I'm in this race.

It's pretty simple:

I'm a mother, a wife, and an educator who has spent decades teaching students in this district. I've met hundreds of parents and did my utmost to improve the lives of the kiddos I served. **I'm running because I'm sick and tired of seeing our community come dead last -- in income, job opportunities, environmental quality, and so much more.** Generation after generation, year after year, nothing seems to change.

**Kevin McCarthy hasn't just ignored our community, he works against us.** He's out for vain leadership roles, plays politics, and appeases Trump at every turn. Someone needed to step up. That's what I've always done, and it's why I'm in this race:

The tides are turning in this district, and folks are starting to see McCarthy for who he really is. Even conservative news outlets are publishing op-eds imploring Republicans to vote against him. His approval rating has plummeted amongst registered voters, which makes this primary a critical opportunity.

I am hopeful it will be the first option, but I’ll be honest: we have not sealed the deal. It all depends on how this next week goes. That’s why I’m humbly asking one last time... This is make or break, and there is so much at stake. Together, we have built a movement, which is now coming to fruition in amazing ways. I am filled with hope for what we can accomplish together if we just get over this hurdle. [Your support will lift us over this last hurdle and to victory on June 7](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_may31&n=4). At times, this campaign has been grueling. I’ve worked harder than I thought possible, and we’ve been tested time and again. But we’ve fought through every obstacle – because we believe in what we’re fighting for. We believe in the greatness of our country. We believe in the promise of our state. We believe California is worth fighting for and America is worth saving. Thank you so much for your support, and thank you for being in the fight. [You can make a quick, secure, and urgently needed citizen donation on our website](https://kevinkiley.nationbuilder.com/r?u=09K6E4GvoPozZ73mzf50y5etLj1_9wCfyRoQ3wvVmv-GOhHPWzgYbh54Gph7Pyuk3g2mp41Qa8XyLKk0CnWqFcPhfo-70bh2d9FGRmWv-G0iUqqLQazIF6cOfkGWrQv5&e=eff202566bfe6143aa18c9c627e100fe&utm_source=kevinkiley&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=final_may31&n=5). With hopefulness and resolve,
Kevin p.s. I’ll be making a call to our Voter Outreach team at the close of business today, to let them know what we are able to do based on the donations that come in. Dear Friends,

In the face of an epidemic of gun violence, a historic affordability crisis, and a rising tide of intolerance, our nation is at a pivotal moment. I’m incredibly proud to be Jared Moskowitz’s campaign manager because I know that Jared is the strong Democratic leader we need fighting for us.

# We can't all stay inside.
Last September I was shot in the arm in this exact same spot. The EMT told me not to jog this way anymore and I still jogged but not in this spot again. My PTSD has been real too. Been jumpy when gas triggers pop or rocks hit windshields. Even this morning I felt the urge to cover my neck up as I approached this spot. I felt like flinching. Getting shot happens so fast and you lose so much blood so fast.

Anyhow, I ran this way because I love neighborhood runs. I run toward the direction of the cars because I love waving at people. They motivate me and the honks make me feel it’s reciprocal. I’m not a tough guy or trying to prove a point. I’ve just chosen a direction in life and the road is too narrow for me to turn back.

Gun violence is really why I decided to run for Congress. All over the country people are dealing with this issue, but especially in Chicago. Leadership to me is about action and taking a stand for what you believe in. I’m introducing the [Root Causes of Gun Violence Act](https://cole2022.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7401cdbeeb0470d9b36be09ed&id=aa413a3bdd&e=339f142c50) on day one to address the system failures causing it. This is day one for me and it’s personal.

**Summertime is here and we can’t all stay inside or they win. We can’t all move away or they win.**

**We have less than 30 days to go** **and I want to make sure we have someone in Congress that’s never going to give up on what they believe in. Who’s never going to stop fighting for the life we deserve.**

Yours in service,
Jahmal

clean_body: Summertime is here and we can’t all stay inside or they win. We can’t all move away or they win. | | | | | | | | We can't all stay inside. Last September I was shot in the arm in this exact same spot. The EMT told me not to jog this way anymore and I still jogged but not in this spot again. My PTSD has been real too. Been jumpy when gas triggers pop or rocks hit windshields. Even this morning I felt the urge to cover my neck up as I approached this spot. I felt like flinching. Getting shot happens so fast and you lose so much blood so fast. Anyhow, I ran this way because I love neighborhood runs. I run toward the direction of the cars because I love waving at people. They motivate me and the honks make me feel it’s reciprocal. I’m not a tough guy or trying to prove a point. I’ve just chosen a direction in life and the road is too narrow for me to turn back. Gun violence is really why I decided to run for Congress. All over the country people are dealing with this issue, but especially in Chicago. Leadership to me is about action and taking a stand for what you believe in. I’m introducing the on day one to address the system failures causing it. This is day one for me and it’s personal. Summertime is here and we can’t all stay inside or they win. We can’t all move away or they win. We have less than 30 days to go and I want to make sure we have someone in Congress that’s never going to give up on what they believe in. Who’s never going to stop fighting for the life we deserve. Yours in service, Jahmal | "DONATE TODAY" | Come get your yard signs! We will have our first yard sign pick-up this Saturday from 10am-1pm at 8035 S. Wabash. If you can't make this time, we will have another time next week as well. | for a screening of "A Tiny Ripple of Hope" followed by a Q&A with Jahmal and the director, Jason. We'll be at the historic Davis Theater in Lincoln Square on June 13th at 7pm! with us! We'll be running a 5K to get out the vote, register voters and give them an action plan to get out. We'll be in Hyde Park on June 18th, details forthcoming. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Copyright © 2022 Friends of Jahmal Cole, All rights reserved.

subject: Fwd: Did you see Sen. Blumenthal's urgent email?
