body:
Friend, with just hours left before tonight's end-of-month fundraising deadline, I need to follow up on Sen. Blumenthal's urgent message below.
---
**The GOP is going all in to flip this seat red and deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell, but we 're still $1,033 short of what we need to keep this campaign on track to fight back and win.** The stakes in our country are just too high to _almost_ reach our goal. We need to raise every last dollar to keep our radical, Trump-loving opponents out of power and make progress on critical issues like gun safety reform and upholding reproductive freedom nationwide.
Because you're a member of this grassroots team, I know how much you care about protecting and expanding rational Senate control. **[So please, before tonight's midnight deadline, will you rush a donation now to keep this seat in the hands of someone who shares your concern for our democracy and its precious institutions?](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1191-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
Thank you so much - your support makes a real difference.
Max Glass
Campaign Manager
Blumenthal for Senate
\---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: **Richard Blumenthal**
Date: Tue, May 31, 2022
Subject: There's too much at stake to fall short

[ ](http://salsa4.salsalabs.com/dia/track.jsp?v=2&c=aT0UoNNLz10nN1XBSipYAhF4fWzt9FUP&url=http%3A%2F%2Frichardblumenthal.com%2F)
Friend, if even one seat flips red in November, the GOP will regain Senate control - which is why Mitch McConnell and his allies are watching my campaign closely for any sign of vulnerability.
But before I continue, I want to take a moment to share how grateful I am for your continued support. When it matters most, I can always count on you to step up. Thank you.
**With our critical end-of-month fundraising deadline quickly approaching, we 're forecasted to fall $2,461 short of what we need to stay on track.**
**But we cannot ignore the urgency of this moment: we cannot signal to Mitch McConnell and the entire GOP establishment that they should target Connecticut 's Senate seat. We cannot allow ourselves to fall into that position - not when so much is at stake.**
Not when the Republicans in the Senate blocked a defensive violence prevention bill that the House passed just days ago in response to this country's endless gun violence epidemic.1
Not when Oklahoma has banned abortion outright. And a new women's healthcare clinic in Casper, Wyoming, has been torched right before it opens.2
Not when millions are expected to be stripped of their reproductive healthcare at any given moment by the Trump-weighted Supreme Court, and GOP leaders like Mitch McConnell are weighing the possibility of a _national_ abortion ban if they retake Senate control.
Not when I'm facing radical, opponents who - if elected - will be a rubber stamp on disastrous policies like tax hikes on millions of seniors and low-income Americans.
**A Republican majority would be a _nightmare_ for our country. That's why coming up short on big goals like this is simply not an option. So please, I'm counting on _you_ to help me close this budget gap and ensure we have the resources to bolster our campaign operations to defend this seat - for safety from gun violence, reproductive rights, accountability for Donald Trump, and so much more.**
**I know you 're someone who cares deeply about protecting Senate control, so I hope you'll come through today in this critical moment for our nation: [Please, before my end-of-month deadline, will you donate $5 or more to defend this Senate seat and keep the Senate sane? Every bit of grassroots support will make a critical difference in the challenging months ahead.](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1191-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)**
With so much gratitude,
Dick

2 Mead Gruver, Associated Press, ABC News, "Police suspect arson in fire at Wyoming abortion clinic site," May 25, 2022, [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/fire-damages-wyoming-abortion-clinic-ahead-june-opening-84968253
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com.

| | We cannot look away at this moment of history or pretend that thoughts and prayers are the only things we can offer as gun violence ravages our country. **Because, as a nation, we see what happens when those who wish to hurt others have access to dangerous weapons. We see it again and again and again.** From Columbine to Sandy Hook to Parkland to Uvalde, and far too many others, our classrooms have become the scene of incomprehensible devastation too many times, as have our theaters, our concerts, our grocery stores – even our places of worship. **We must work to stop these tragedies, and we must act immediately.** I believe common ground on gun safety exists. Nearly 90 percent of Americans support background checks for all firearm sales. Yet the influence of the National Rifle Association – perhaps our nation's single worst example of powerful interest groups determining policy against the interests of the American people – has long stood in the way. The tragedy at Uvalde may have temporarily broken the NRA's grip on Congress, and I and my Democratic colleagues in the House and Senate will do all we can to find bipartisan agreement on sensible gun safety measures, including background checks, red flag laws, and age of purchase requirements. I am hopeful we can achieve this critical first step. _I believe Congress must commit to making the Uvalde shooting the very last time our families, our communities, and our nation endure this senseless loss of our children's lives._ **So does the Alliance for Gun Responsibility, which is why they have endorsed my campaign.** No single candidate or organization can change the course of gun violence in America. But if we all stand together, our united grassroots front can overcome any political obstacle in our way and enact meaningful change. Together, we _will_ pass common sense gun safety laws and we _will_ get the dominance of big money special interests like the gun lobby out of our politics. Thank you, Alliance for Gun Responsibility for standing with us in this cause. _Rick_ |

I’ve always been dedicated to helping Ohio’s working families.

In my time on Cincinnati City Council, I’ve fought for our children and families, especially those most marginalized. I led the charge to provide two years of quality preschool to our city’s three and four year olds. And I’ve led on transformative eviction prevention measures and major ethics reforms at City Hall.

And now, I’m running for Congress in an extremely competitive district to get real results for the children and families in Ohio’s first district.

My team and I need your help to prepare for this closely-watched race, and that means meeting all of our campaign budget goals. Not only that, but Maggie Hassan - _my Democrat opponent who votes for Joe Biden’s agenda and nominees 98% of the time_ \- has been raising huge sums from her out-of-state donors. **If we don’t respond now, we simply won’t have the resources to compete with her closer to Election Day.** That’s bad news for everyone who wants to see the crises under her and Biden’s watch come to an end. Friend,

**The Primary election is one week away.** I want to thank everyone for their support so far, remind everyone to vote, and ask you to remind your friends and family to vote. Elections are not decided by money – or connections – they’re decided by voters deciding to turn out.

I want to ask everyone, over the course of this week – to talk to your neighbors and friends about voting. I need you to motivate them on my behalf.

**For Democrats,** this election is about standing up for our democratic system and our constitutional rights. Doug voted against certifying a free and fair election. He voted against protecting the right to vote. He cheered on the (probable) end of _Roe v. Wade_. Some Democrats may find me too centrist: to them I say that we live in a “red” district, that a “progressive” is unelectable in the “State of Jefferson”, and that I’m a whole lot better than Doug.

**For Independents,** a centrist Democrat is the perfect fit for you. Voters in the middle are poorly represented by a far-right radical like Doug LaMalfa, and they shouldn’t vote for a fringe Republican when they have a man of the middle like me.

**For Republicans,** even they must know that Doug LaMalfa has been in office too long and it’s time for change. Maybe they want a veteran to represent them in Congress or maybe they want a candidate who will stand up for “conservative values” against the strain of “Trumpist populism” currently infecting the GOP. Heck, I’ll take their vote even if it’s just to get some new Republican options in 2024.

Whatever tack you take, I want you to be talking. Every vote counts, so I’m hoping you can lend a hand and ask your neighbors to cast their ballots for me.

| | Dear Peter, We’re glad whenever journalists cover the excesses of powerful figures. But this weekend’s stories about Paul Pelosi’s arrest in Napa ultimately demonstrate the sad collapse of journalism in this country. To the extent there’s a story about Paul Pelosi that matters, it’s how his stock trades have benefited from Nancy’s inside information, how they have “informed” (and skewed) her positions as a leader in Congress. name: =?utf-8?Q?Kathleen=20Brown?=
subject: Uvalde: One week later
body:
I'm still reeling | |
---
| | | [ ](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=be42321216&e=4712f71bea)
---
| Friends,

How are you doing?

It has been one week since the tragedy in Uvalde. One week since twenty-one beautiful lives were taken.

Personally, I am still sick to my stomach.

I am heartbroken over the loss of these lives and grief-stricken over the unimaginable pain I know each family is experiencing.

I am angry that yet _another_ school shooting occurred and frustrated that it was preventable.

**Action is needed now.**

We have data-backed solutions that show gun violence is curbed when thorough background checks and gun registration is required, a waiting period to purchase high-capacity guns is instituted, and all gun sales are tracked. I support all these measures. This doesn’t mean taking away the right to own a gun – it means ensuring practical firearms are _only_ purchased by responsible individuals.

[Read my full statement on my website here](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=1213d19afa&e=4712f71bea).

For our students and families all throughout Texas and the United States, we must do more.

**This starts with electing representatives who support gun safety measures and take direct action that puts your safety first.**

Your vote this November matters more than ever, and as you cast your vote, I implore you to think about the impact you have on the future of this state and country.

If you are in a position to do so, I hope you will [support my campaign](https://kathleenfortx.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=09fca73837c97c9ddd5e5e266&id=1a841b705d&e=4712f71bea) so I can take action that will save lives.

Kathleen Brown
Democrat for Congress
TX-13

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being energy-independent and a net exporter of natural gas. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. He is a devoted husband and proud father of three children.

There is no family fortune behind this drive; no generations of beer barons or Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization. Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Friend -- I know you’ve been hearing a lot from me, so I promise to keep this short:
In just a few short hours we’ll reach our **last** end-of-month deadline before the June 7 primary. As of right now, we’re still $4,826 short of our goal, and we need every cent to help get out the vote and secure this Democratic seat.
I wouldn’t be asking if it wasn’t urgent: is there any chance you can rush a donation? **$35** would be incredible, but any amount would make a big difference before this deadline hits.
Here’s a personalized link you can use to donate: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cn-q2-2022?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45969976/348269204/-10092236?refcode=em-5.31.22-all-a-2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwY2EwOWJjZi0zYWUxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1hlOLNMNrcRWSuZYYX6j37vybsplrS7vkv8IokoEDcM=)

I’ve taken on Ryan Zinke before, and I know I can beat him again. When he tried to reduce Bears Ears National Monument by over 75%, I worked with local leaders to fight back -- **and we won.**

So what do you say, friend? Can you chip in just a few bucks to help us get there?
Thanks in advance for your support,

_-Cora_

body:
With only a few hours left before our end-of-month fundraising deadline, I wanted to share a little about why I entered this crowded race.

** _“It is, in a way, an odd thing to honor those who died in defense of our country, in defense of us, in wars far away. The imagination plays a trick. We see these soldiers in our mind as old and wise. We see them as something like the Founding Fathers, grave and gray haired.” _**
**_“But most of them were boys when they died, and they gave up two lives — the one they were living and the one they would have lived. When they died, they gave up their chance to be husbands and fathers and grandfathers. They gave up their chance to be revered old men. They gave up everything for our country, for us. And all we can do is remember.”_ – President Ronald Reagan, 1985.**
This past weekend, I was reminded of this quote from Ronald Reagan. Of the lives that were lost, in the prime of their life, so we could remain free. Like most military families, my husband and I know someone who made such a sacrifice. Who didn’t get to come home to start a family - or left one behind. On Friday, my office was honored to add one such warrior to the Prince William County War Memorial. [](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=72647c111dd442c5998f7e6966700baf&_e=dokWAo8HhCKVyKWkmcW87b3ukM2YkDE-Y7Ynqua5auIiXveuBVbCmy-ny_wsGPwg4dcQHhCaq0wEJQuU0XgVpg_UoG5gLCXJtE7W8IMFKbzeYWw8vowFwviJK4K-iCPyKT-Sy_0P782xjqlbrsLMqhiOp45EOuzl6uKRjVTeRaNEDZrdwz79GvufrXwCH7XDgC8DagxUkcnjt-aFXnNYrBExCYllOEYZuct0xw9w_9E-iU_40Oe-CaoSAYc6buVXkUCLK29ubmcChqLyJS-LoZ3SBA83AHQP6fKkptzuqrfQX9sCKdnLbllYzUi379dV3Sm9uUAxbLLDDqQDxeC_Jhkb6GbnS3gjnrhfORZK79z-A0GEzA9zv6_riOCnwi3QHMnTQZuGBCSvlMatjpzlu17fEfBRG0JGU7XvcXbIzqNiXAgZivscomJUohJXFcteaF97q3_-YIY0YFbP49FalbHckCfbNTux7knrVbjzaqls-BbmlXcFDAddwcrzHDy4) [](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=72647c111dd442c5998f7e6966700baf&_e=dokWAo8HhCKVyKWkmcW87b3ukM2YkDE-Y7Ynqua5auIiXveuBVbCmy-ny_wsGPwg4dcQHhCaq0wEJQuU0XgVpg_UoG5gLCXJtE7W8IMFKbzeYWw8vowFwviJK4K-iCPyKT-Sy_0P782xjqlbrsLMqhiOp45EOuzl6uKRjVTeRaNEDZrdwz79GvufrXwCH7XDgC8DagxUkcnjt-aFXnNYrBExCYllOEYZuct0xw9w_9E-iU_40Oe-CaoSAYc6buVXkUCLK29ubmcChqLyJS-LoZ3SBA83AHQP6fKkptzuqrd0oHnhgj2k07Tv-7uGRMp3Em8ksusKWrBvrkBuQxdf6-P0-cz87TLuv51tmN8iQbOOZ0h6EV-8xY4C5DHU8niaKYt2PfbunYOpciop_91c3-mvCGUgYvG3Y8-9iX_WtvL98C5TTcflge-xXEybpkMiIHWl40Bf_mq3g0-HT4mwfClzOSR2NcCwor6xkEW3EFuzafipE9ua-AWsli4_MKrc) Special Agent, Forrest Nelson Leamon was a resident of Woodbridge.**He was killed in a helicopter crash with two other agents and seven service members following a counter narcotics operation in Afghanistan in October of 2009.** He was only 37 and left behind his wife and a child he never got to meet. Agent Leamon, who was a U.S. Navy Veteran of nine years, and all who died that day are buried together at Arlington National Cemetery. [](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=72647c111dd442c5998f7e6966700baf&_e=dokWAo8HhCKVyKWkmcW87b3ukM2YkDE-Y7Ynqua5auIiXveuBVbCmy-ny_wsGPwg4dcQHhCaq0wEJQuU0XgVpg_UoG5gLCXJtE7W8IMFKbzeYWw8vowFwviJK4K-iCPyKT-Sy_0P782xjqlbrsLMqhiOp45EOuzl6uKRjVTeRaNEDZrdwz79GvufrXwCH7XDgC8DagxUkcnjt-aFXnNYrBExCYllOEYZuct0xw9w_9E-iU_40Oe-CaoSAYc6buVXkUCLK29ubmcChqLyJS-LoZ3SBA83AHQP6fKkptzuqrf97SvniDz9BpSq89l_Z4eOZKsNvVc3L80hEFeSTTbzzXRRdTRmVwxooWK9IUQV6vAHmdc-3cyV5lI5vomlFp17Z-9eatYUfQWuv9So0ONiiza3rb7LtVlNI38K7NzB0wEELtU57Y-TlXBQ2WfFk6wNvGhgg6dS7qgXbd0KZT2ScLMw-8MEN3FurQNOe9AZ5YwWFnNjDlqO8EQeVZtEQ9VS) These are the lives we strive to remember, not just on Memorial Day for a few passing moments in between cookouts - but every day.**Special Agent Leamon’s face is the face of our freedom.** And we must never forget it.

In addition to the service last Friday, I also took part in the ceremony at Quantico Cemetery and a Memorial Day Barbecue at American Legion Post 364 in Woodbridge where I was honored to get to lead the Pledge of Allegiance. These solemn remembrances brought tears to my eyes, and also a resolve, that we must always – always, fight for and preserve our Country. The best Country, that is worthy of their sacrifice. ** ** **Uvalde Tragedy and Defending our Constitutional Freedoms**

We’re all still shaken by the tragic events in Uvalde, Texas. As a law enforcement officer and mother of two children still in school, those images hit me like a ton of bricks.**Our thoughts and prayers continue to go out to the Uvalde community and the families impacted by this terrible tragedy.**

As the American Left mocks such sentiments in their efforts to disarm you, it’s important that we have a conversation moving forward based on facts. **This happened in a supposed gun-free zone.** The literal definition of a**gun-controlled area.** And as a result, there was no good guy with a gun able to stop a lunatic until the damage had been done. While I love and will always support our police, it is clear that they cannot be there to defend us 100% of the time.

Nearly every mass shooting in America has occurred in a gun-free zone. It’s time we start to acknowledge this. As a member of the Prince William Board of Supervisors,**I have defended and advocated to expand our School Resource Officer Program over the objections of Democrats.** Having SRO’s and good guys with guns is the only way to try and prevent this from happening again without infringing upon people’s constitutional liberties.**Gun control made those children and teachers sitting ducks. We must never allow it to happen again.

**Conservative Parents Leading the Way**

As we address the root causes of what leads an 18 year old man to take such sadistic actions, it’s vitally important that we examine the state of the home and family structure in American households. **It is the home and the family unit within where Godly principles and respect for our fellow man must be instilled.

**That’s why I’m so thankful for groups like the Conservative Parents of Orange County.** This group arose in opposition to the dastardly things our children were being tought in school, pitting one against each other, simply because of the color of their skin via Critical Race Theory. These parents have made a conscious decision to play a vital role in their children’s lives, which doesn’t end when they walk out the door for school each day.**Strong families are the bedrock of strong communities.** And strong communities are what make a strong America.
[](http://links.yeslivega.com/u/click?_t=59c0f017400946ec807e855a5aba0785&_m=72647c111dd442c5998f7e6966700baf&_e=dokWAo8HhCKVyKWkmcW87b3ukM2YkDE-Y7Ynqua5auIiXveuBVbCmy-ny_wsGPwg4dcQHhCaq0wEJQuU0XgVpg_UoG5gLCXJtE7W8IMFKbzeYWw8vowFwviJK4K-iCPyKT-Sy_0P782xjqlbrsLMqhiOp45EOuzl6uKRjVTeRaNEDZrdwz79GvufrXwCH7XDgC8DagxUkcnjt-aFXnNYrBExCYllOEYZuct0xw9w_9E-iU_40Oe-CaoSAYc6buVXkUCLK29ubmcChqLyJS-LoZ3SBA83AHQP6fKkptzuqre_RaVw_jI-ROjrvUMsreUq457boMcyu_o1m4y85FLP_x6EJhpGpiZcIwiIM2rSCqpKJB-CFWSI00qXKQ_T9ZKPwqEH6mXfZ9GgKZxgeJxeedOXRnR-A2tDR1Ccql2jw8iPjU__OP3ieUK2IXPkZTitRhAhQjG8gCocykl-OdjfDPYrMZQBeMu_xGja_rogdTrpJ_8wnnhUm7anuuSm7qRu)
I was honored to spend my Friday night getting to talk to and know these fine parents. One thing is for sure. Because of their involvement, the future indeed looks more bright for Orange County.**I hope to be a representative worthy of safeguarding the liberty of their children and for generations to come.**

**Endorsement Alert

This past week we were pleased to roll out the endorsement of Davie Bossie, **President Trump’s 2016 Deputy Campaign Manager and founder and President of Citizens United. David has spent a lifetime fighting in the trenches for the conservative movement and I’m honored to have his support in addition to so many other grassroots conservatives, including: **Congressman Dave Brat** **Ken Cuccinelli** **Senator Ted Cruz** **Corey Stewart** **Ginni Thomas** **Congressman Louie Gohmert** **Larry Pratt, Gun Owners of America** **Richard Viguerie** **Greene County Sheriff, Steve Smith** **Prince William County Sheriff, Glen Hill** **Orange County School Board Member, Chelsea Quintern** **Greene County School Board Vice Chair, Todd Sansom**
**Other Events

Prince William/Culpeper/Orange GOP Meetings**

This past week, Team Vega was represented at the Prince William, Culpeper, and Orange County GOP meetings. It was great to see so many fired up faces as we head down the finish line towards the June 21st primary.

**Downtown Abby -_No Friend of Police_**

In this week’s edition of _Downtown Abby_**, we examine a different area in which the Abigail Spanberger who votes in Washington, DC is different than the one who comes around during campaign time in Culpeper and Fredericksburg.**

Over the last few months, Spanberger has made it seem as if she is the best friend a Democrat could possibly be to our police. But you see, this is an election year ploy. clean_body: | “It is, in a way, an odd thing to honor those who died in defense of our country, in defense of us, in wars far away. The imagination plays a trick. We see these soldiers in our mind as old and wise. We see them as something like the Founding Fathers, grave and gray haired.” “But most of them were boys when they died, and they gave up two lives — the one they were living and the one they would have lived. When they died, they gave up their chance to be husbands and fathers and grandfathers. They gave up their chance to be revered old men. They gave up everything for our country, for us. And all we can do is remember.” – President Ronald Reagan, 1985. This past weekend, I was reminded of this quote from Ronald Reagan. Of the lives that were lost, in the prime of their life, so we could remain free. Like most military families, my husband and I know someone who made such a sacrifice. Who didn’t get to come home to start a family - or left one behind. On Friday, my office was honored to add one such warrior to the Prince William County War Memorial. Special Agent, Forrest Nelson Leamon was a resident of Woodbridge.He was killed in a helicopter crash with two other agents and seven service members following a counter narcotics operation in Afghanistan in October of 2009. He was only 37 and left behind his wife and a child he never got to meet. Agent Leamon, who was a U.S. Navy Veteran of nine years, and all who died that day are buried together at Arlington National Cemetery. These are the lives we strive to remember, not just on Memorial Day for a few passing moments in between cookouts - but every day.Special Agent Leamon’s face is the face of our freedom. And we must never forget it. In addition to the service last Friday, I also took part in the ceremony at Quantico Cemetery and a Memorial Day Barbecue at American Legion Post 364 in Woodbridge where I was honored to get to lead the Pledge of Allegiance. These solemn remembrances brought tears to my eyes, and also a resolve, that we must always – always, fight for and preserve our Country. The best Country, that is worthy of their sacrifice. Uvalde Tragedy and Defending our Constitutional Freedoms We’re all still shaken by the tragic events in Uvalde, Texas. As a law enforcement officer and mother of two children still in school, those images hit me like a ton of bricks.Our thoughts and prayers continue to go out to the Uvalde community and the families impacted by this terrible tragedy. As the American Left mocks such sentiments in their efforts to disarm you, it’s important that we have a conversation moving forward based on facts. This happened in a supposed gun-free zone. The literal definition of agun-controlled area. And as a result, there was no good guy with a gun able to stop a lunatic until the damage had been done. While I love and will always support our police, it is clear that they cannot be there to defend us 100% of the time. Nearly every mass shooting in America has occurred in a gun-free zone. It’s time we start to acknowledge this. As a member of the Prince William Board of Supervisors,I have defended and advocated to expand our School Resource Officer Program over the objections of Democrats. Having SRO’s and good guys with guns is the only way to try and prevent this from happening again without infringing upon people’s constitutional liberties.Gun control made those children and teachers sitting ducks. We must never allow it to happen again. Conservative Parents Leading the Way As we address the root causes of what leads an 18 year old man to take such sadistic actions, it’s vitally important that we examine the state of the home and family structure in American households. It is the home and the family unit within where Godly principles and respect for our fellow man must be instilled. That’s why I’m so thankful for groups like the Conservative Parents of Orange County. This group arose in opposition to the dastardly things our children were being tought in school, pitting one against each other, simply because of the color of their skin via Critical Race Theory. These parents have made a conscious decision to play a vital role in their children’s lives, which doesn’t end when they walk out the door for school each day.Strong families are the bedrock of strong communities. And strong communities are what make a strong America. I was honored to spend my Friday night getting to talk to and know these fine parents. One thing is for sure. Because of their involvement, the future indeed looks more bright for Orange County.I hope to be a representative worthy of safeguarding the liberty of their children and for generations to come. Endorsement Alert This past week we were pleased to roll out the endorsement of Davie Bossie, President Trump’s 2016 Deputy Campaign Manager and founder and President of Citizens United. David has spent a lifetime fighting in the trenches for the conservative movement and I’m honored to have his support in addition to so many other grassroots conservatives, including: Congressman Dave Brat Ken Cuccinelli Senator Ted Cruz Corey Stewart Ginni Thomas Congressman Louie Gohmert Larry Pratt, Gun Owners of America Richard Viguerie Greene County Sheriff, Steve Smith Prince William County Sheriff, Glen Hill Orange County School Board Member, Chelsea Quintern Greene County School Board Vice Chair, Todd Sansom Other Events Prince William/Culpeper/Orange GOP Meetings This past week, Team Vega was represented at the Prince William, Culpeper, and Orange County GOP meetings. It was great to see so many fired up faces as we head down the finish line towards the June 21st primary. Downtown Abby -No Friend of Police In this week’s edition of Downtown Abby, we examine a different area in which the Abigail Spanberger who votes in Washington, DC is different than the one who comes around during campaign time in Culpeper and Fredericksburg. Over the last few months, Spanberger has made it seem as if she is the best friend a Democrat could possibly be to our police. But you see, this is an election year ploy. Immediately following, Spanberger. This is why people distrust politicians and confidence in Washington is at an all-time low. The real Abby, Downtown Abby, of course and. When you vote for Abigail Spanberger, this is what you get. 2020 was the last year she’ll bamboozle the voters of the Seventh District.We’re making sure of that. \- far outside the mainstream of Virginia’s Seventh Congressional District. Worshiping with PDC On Sunday I was able to worship with Igelsia Puerta del Cielo as part of Missions Week. Very thankful to Pastor Luis and Ruben for their faith and love of community. Radio Buzz This past Tuesday I was on WHCV with Joe Thomas in the morningtalking about Ms. Spanberger’s lack of support for police and how we hope to bring this home for the Seventh District on June 21st and beyond. . Upcoming Events Meet and Greet with Del. John McGuire in Fredericksburg This coming Thursday we’re having a meet and greet with Navy SEAL and former 7th District Republican candidate for Congress, Delegate John McGuire, at Crossroads Baptist Church in Fredericksburg. Delegate McGuire has been a conservative leader in Richmond and an enthusiastic supporter of our campaign. Please check out the EventBrite link below for more details! Culpeper Rally with The Honorable Ken Cuccinelli On Friday evening, June 3rd,we’ll be joined by former Virginia Attorney General, Ken Cuccinelli, for a rally at the GOP House in Culpeper. After serving as Attorney General, he of course went on to become Deputy Secretary of Homeland Security under President Trump, helping to give the Biden Administration arguably the most secure border in American history.I’m blessed to have earned Ken’s trust as my campaign chairman. Please join us at 6pm in Culpeper to hear from two of Virginia’s most fearless conservative voices! Details here: Super Saturday Door Knocking And on Saturday, we’ll be getting together at 9:30am at 18354 Quantico Gateway Drive in Triangle for a day of getting exercise and knocking on doors in the Seventh District. So far, the weather forecast looks great. If you can join us or would prefer to make phone calls for Team Vega instead, please contact our campaign manager, Eric Page, at mailto:Eric@yeslivega.com. Early Voting Continues + Weekend Voting Election Month-and-a-half rolls on with early voting throughout the district.). In addition, beginning June 11th, Saturday voting will also be available from 9-5 at designated locations.Traditional Election Day voting will be available from 7am-6pm on June 21st at your regular voting location. Until next week - we’ll see you on the trail! | God Bless, Yesli Vega Conservative Republican for Congress Virginia's 7th District | Military Wife. Mother. We’re giving it all we got to make sure we can show the strength of this movement and finally beat Rand Paul on Election Day 💪. 2. But right now, we’re not where we should be if we want to hit our goal of raising $500,000 — and we need to turn things around quickly. I told the team that I trust y’all to pull through and help make sure we have the funds to show Rand Paul we’re ready to take his seat. [ ]So, if you’re able, can you please make a donation to help us get to our $500,000 goal for May? Anything you can give would be greatly appreciated. Thank you, Peter. 🙏 I’m so thankful to you for putting your trust in me to be your nominee. I hope you and your loved ones are safe and well. — Charles Sent from my iPhone

name: Sarah Godlewski
subject: I want to be honest with you for a moment
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sarah for Wisconsin
body:
Our campaign wouldn’t be as competitive as it is — let alone the only one polling ahead of Ron Johnson in the most recent head-to-head poll — without your support every step of the way. I can’t thank you enough. Hey, can you spare a few minutes? I want to be honest with you for a moment.

With only a few hours remaining until our end-of-month deadline, we still have a significant way to go in order to reach our fundraising goals. So, I’m humbly asking you to donate to my campaign before midnight. Anything you can give will directly fund our efforts to flip Wisconsin’s Senate seat.

**Here’s your personal link to contribute:[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/godlewski-may22&refcode2=dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/45961571/348236901/43152360?refcode=em22_220531_eom5_fnd_gq_act___sg_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220531_eom5_fnd_gq_act___sg_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODI4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NzMwMzY0Yy0yM2UxLWVjMTEtYjY1Ni0yODE4NzhiODUxMTAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=pHbUMYG4ZcUqH_g9az3IcYl087vcfWvYoFQxPYS0LYY=)**

The momentum we’re seeing in the latest polls and on the ground right now is incredible. People are fired up about our fight to replace Ron Johnson with a U.S. Senator who’s going to pass commonsense gun safety legislation, protect abortion access, restore voting rights, and so much more.

**I’m ready to be that U.S. Senator.**

But Washington Republicans just announced several massive ad buys — $15 million from Mitch McConnell’s Super PAC, $9 million from the National Republican Senatorial Committee, and Ron Johnson has been flooding the airwaves since he announced his re-election campaign.

This could be one of the most expensive election cycles in Wisconsin history. Plus, we’re at a cash-on-hand disadvantage. We’ll need a surge in grassroots donations over the next few hours if we want our message to cut above the noise and reach voters.

Our work in 2018 and 2020 to help elect Democrats running for state-level offices made a big difference. In states like Pennsylvania, Kansas, and Wisconsin, Democratic governors vetoed gerrymandered maps.

body:
We're officially on the ballot, Peter.
Peter,

Now that I've officially filed for reelection, our campaign is in full swing! Last Saturday, I had the chance to knock doors with some of our top volunteers in Grays Harbor. We had some important conversations with voters about what's at stake up and down the ballot this November.

Together, we have accomplished a lot - from fighting this pandemic, getting our economy back on track, supporting military families and veterans, and passing a historic infrastructure bill that will fix our roads and bridges and give people access to broadband.

But Peter, it's clear that our work has only just begun, and with so much on the line -- from voting rights, reproductive freedom, our environment, and more -- we can't slow down. Not for a minute.

This grassroots team has been there every step of the way, and together, we can build another winning campaign. But it's important that I hit the ground running as we approach the primary election. And now that I'm officially on the ballot, I need your support more than ever to help power us to victory.

[**With you by my side, I know we can move this country forward -- but I certainly can't do it on my own. Will you chip in $20, $10, or even $5 to help keep me fighting for our region?**](https://act.myngp.com/el/IM-zQjHX7HYHybDCqR33NWXLOdp5lCx-wWDURXbUkxc=/9oimlJNT9GGbfc_2aEdTrsLt40QBSYAbZTrwW32GjUY=?refcode=em22_220531_eom2_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220531_eom2_fnd_gq_act___DK_ettx&utm_medium=email&email={{EmailAddress%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&firstname={{FirstName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&lastname={{LastName%2CDefaultTo%3D}}&zip={{ZipCode%2CDefaultTo%3D}})

Sincerely,

Team Gibbs

body:
Filing day is over. Now we need you. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/drscottjensen.com/its-game-time?e=33b11688c1)
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

Filing has ended in Minnesota. It very much looks like Dr. Scott Jensen and I will be the candidates to take on Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan in November. I know Scott emailed you earlier today, but before end your day - I wanted to ask one more time: [can you help us meet our fundraising deadline](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=1c7433c321&e=33b11688c1)?

We're $2500 away at this point. [Anything helps](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=fddcab17d3&e=33b11688c1).

Our campaign has committed to taking no money from big tech or big pharma. We know that in order to combat Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan's far-left machine, we need to rely on every-day Minnesotans. Our top donors are homemakers, farmers, retirees, laborers, law enforcement, entrepreneurs, retirees - people who love Minnesota and want to see it thrive again.

The DFL has [been caught red-handed](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=39f5b395cb&e=33b11688c1) trying to rig a 3rd-Party convention because they fear us. Magically, a _different_ far-left [3rd Party Candidate has just dropped out](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=696036216d&e=33b11688c1) of the race today, helping Tim Walz's chances. The political games these Democrats play are exhausting.

**You know what I think?** I think Tim Walz and Peggy Flanagan are scared. They didn't want to face Jensen/Birk in 2022, and I have a feeling their internal polling confirms those fears. Let's send a message **TONIGHT** that Minnesotans are ready to take back their state. We're ready to fight for transparency, accountability, the rule of law, and those sacred rights we so often take for granted: life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness. We're ready to restore freedom in Minnesota.
[**Join us.**](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=fed3dd8c94&e=33b11688c1)**** Please pray about it and consider [giving like you've never given](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=b234382123&e=33b11688c1) to a political ticket before. The stakes are high and we have a huge opportunity!

**Scott Jensen and I are with you.** We will steward your hard-earned money effectively, and "leave everything on the field" in 2022.

[If you can, please help us meet our goal tonight](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=0657cd5caa&e=33b11688c1). Even $5 helps immensely.
Onward to victory!

In Freedom,

Matt Birk
Republican Candidate for Lt. Governor
Running with Dr. Scott Jensen
